19/*
20 eval_cps uses setjmp/longjmp for error handling.
21
22 setjmp/longjmp behavior is undefined:
23 * If the function which called setjmp() returns before longjmp() is
24 called, the behavior is undefined. Some kind of subtle or unsubtle
25 chaos is sure to result.
26
27 * If, in a multithreaded program, a longjmp() call employs an env buffer
28 that was initialized by a call to setjmp() in a different thread, the
29 behavior is undefined.
30
31 As I understand it MISRA C guidelines prohibit (quite completely) any use
32 of setjmp/longjmp for safety-critical applications.
33
34 The LispBM eval_cps evaluator is careful to not fall into either of the
35 undefined behavior situations by:
36 1. setjmp is called in the lbm_run_eval() function which is responsible
37 for running all evaluation.
38 2. longjmp is called as part of the ERROR_CTX/ERROR_AT_CTX macros which
39 are executed by the evaluator in error cases.
40 3. the jump buffers are static (error_jmp_buf).
41 4. The error_ctx/error_at_ctx functions are static.
42 5. The ERROR_CTX/ERROR_AT_CTX/READ_ERROR_CTX macros are only called in
43 static functions.
44 TODO Check static functions that call ERROR_CTX are not called by any
45 non-static function, The only call-chain that leads to a longjmp must
46 originate in lbm_run_eval().
47 => (if the TODO is dealt with) it is impossible to trigger the undefined
48 conditions.
49
50 Possible alternative to setjmp/longjmp is to cram all of the stuff
51 that eval_cps does into a single function and use GOTO to jump between the
52 different continuation and evaluation and error cases. This would be even
53 worse from a "structured programming" viewpoint, but it would also possibly
54 be a bit a faster.
55
56 The setjmp/longjmp error handling applied here is well contained and has
57 been rigorously tested over time. There is a bit more to do in terms of
58 documenting the error handling choices and it would also be nice to statically
59 check/verify that we are ruling out the undefined use cases.
60*/
61

67*/

337/*
338 On ChibiOs the CH_CFG_ST_FREQUENCY setting in chconf.h sets the
339 resolution of the timer used for sleep operations. If this is set
340 to 10KHz the resolution is 100us.
341
342 The CH_CFG_ST_TIMEDELTA specifies the minimum number of ticks that
343 can be safely specified in a timeout directive (wonder if that
344 means sleep-period). The timedelta is set to 2.
345
346 If I have understood these correctly it means that the minimum
347 sleep duration possible is 2 * 100us = 200us.
348*/
349
350#define EVAL_CPS_DEFAULT_STACK_SIZE256 256
351// The intended unit on the QUOTA is us (microseconds) and this should
352// be ensured by the platform support libraries for a given platform.
353#define EVAL_TIME_QUOTA400 400
354#define EVAL_CPS_MIN_SLEEP200 200
355#define EVAL_STEPS_QUOTA10 10
356
357#ifdef LBM_USE_TIME_QUOTA
358static volatile uint32_t eval_time_refill = EVAL_TIME_QUOTA400;
359static uint32_t eval_time_quota = EVAL_TIME_QUOTA400;
360static uint32_t eval_current_quota = 0;
361void lbm_set_eval_time_quota(uint32_t quota) {
362 eval_time_refill = quota;
363}
364#else
365static volatile uint32_t eval_steps_refill = EVAL_STEPS_QUOTA10;
366static uint32_t eval_steps_quota = EVAL_STEPS_QUOTA10;
367void lbm_set_eval_step_quota(uint32_t quota) {
368 eval_steps_refill = quota;
369}

424static unsigned int lbm_events_max = 0;

430static unsigned int lbm_event_queue_item_count(void) {
431 unsigned int res = lbm_events_max;
432 if (!lbm_events_full) {
433 if (lbm_events_head >= lbm_events_tail) {
434 res = lbm_events_head - lbm_events_tail;
435 } else {
436 res = lbm_events_max - lbm_events_tail + lbm_events_head;
437 }
438 }
439 return res;
440}

454static bool_Bool event_internal(lbm_event_type_t event_type, lbm_uint parameter, lbm_uint buf_ptr, lbm_uint buf_len) {
455 bool_Bool r = false0;
456 if (lbm_events) {
457 lbm_mutex_lock(&lbm_events_mutex);
458 if (!lbm_events_full) {
459 lbm_event_t event;
460 event.type = event_type;
461 event.parameter = parameter;
462 event.buf_ptr = buf_ptr;
463 event.buf_len = buf_len;
464 lbm_events[lbm_events_head] = event;
465 lbm_events_head = (lbm_events_head + 1) % lbm_events_max;
466 lbm_events_full = lbm_events_head == lbm_events_tail;
467 r = true1;
468 }
469 lbm_mutex_unlock(&lbm_events_mutex);
470 }
471 return r;
472}

481 t == LBM_TYPE_I0x00000008u ||
482 t == LBM_TYPE_U0x0000000Cu ||
483 t == LBM_TYPE_CHAR0x00000004u) {
484 if (lbm_event_handler_pid > 0) {

486 return event_internal(LBM_EVENT_FOR_HANDLER, 0, (lbm_uint)unboxed, 0);
487 }

489 }
490 return false0;

502static bool_Bool lbm_event_pop(lbm_event_t *event) {

504 bool_Bool r = false0;
505 if (lbm_events_head != lbm_events_tail || lbm_events_full) {
506 *event = lbm_events[lbm_events_tail];
507 lbm_events_tail = (lbm_events_tail + 1) % lbm_events_max;
508 lbm_events_full = false0;

578static lbm_value cons_with_gc(lbm_value head, lbm_value tail, lbm_value remember) {
579 lbm_value res;
580#ifdef LBM_ALWAYS_GC
581 lbm_value always_gc_roots[3] = {head, tail, remember};
582 lbm_gc_mark_roots(always_gc_roots,3);
583 gc();
584#endif
585 if (!lbm_heap_num_free()) {
586 lbm_value roots[3] = {head, tail, remember};
587 lbm_gc_mark_roots(roots,3);
588 gc();
589 if (!lbm_heap_num_free()) {
590 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_MERROR)error_ctx((((0x23) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
591 }
592 }
593
594 res = lbm_heap_state.freelist;
595 lbm_uint heap_ix = lbm_dec_ptr(res);
596 lbm_heap_state.freelist = lbm_heap_state.heap[heap_ix].cdr;
597 lbm_heap_state.num_free--;
598 lbm_heap_state.heap[heap_ix].car = head;
599 lbm_heap_state.heap[heap_ix].cdr = tail;
600 res = lbm_set_ptr_type(res, LBM_TYPE_CONS0x10000000u);
601 return res;
602}

604// ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
605// Stack and CPS
606
607// The CPS system is dependent on a diciplined use of a continuation
608// stack! Continuations are pushed and popped from this stack and
609// between the point in time when a continuation is pushed and when it is popped
610// significant stack "traffic" may have occurred.
611//
612// In the evaluator, functions called things line "eval_X" usually sets up
613// a stack-frame for a future exection of a "cont_X" continuation.
614// Some kind of proof is needed that Things that pushed in a continuation setup-phase
615// are all popped (no more, no less) in a continuation execution phase.
616// continuations "cont_X" also may set up more continuations and in that
617// case they may modify the stack in place or reuse in part or full the
618// stack-frame associated with "cont_X"
619//
620// TODO: for each "eval_X" and "cont_X" pair write an argument or some kind
621// of test that illustrates correct usage of the stack discipline.
622//
623// For now the argument of stack discipline being honored is that all tests
624// pass and no tests end up in stack underflow.
625//
626// Stack overflow is easy to end up in, just write a non-tail-recursive but recursive funtions
627// and run it for a suitably large input.
628//
629// * Potentially tricky situation is "trap" used on a call to a non-tail-recursive function that
630// ends out exhausting stack.
631// # Trap rewinds the stack to the point of trap so it should be perfectly safe to trap even in this situation.
632
633// get_stack_ptr and pop_stack_ptr does in no tests reach
634// the error condition. The check n <= sp is not really needed.
635static inline lbm_uint *get_stack_ptr(eval_context_t *ctx, unsigned int n) {
636 lbm_uint index = ctx->K.sp - n;
637 return &ctx->K.data[index];
638}
639
640// pop_stack_ptr is safe when no GC is performed and
641// the values of the stack will be dropped.
642static inline lbm_uint *pop_stack_ptr(eval_context_t *ctx, unsigned int n) {
643 ctx->K.sp -= n;
644 return &ctx->K.data[ctx->K.sp];
645}
646
647// stack_drop is assuming eval_cps uses a rigoursly tested and principled
648// approach to stack management. If the stack is being abused by the runtime
649// system this is usually very quickly discovered using the test suite as
650// the behavior of the RTS becomes completely wacko.
651static inline void stack_drop(eval_context_t *ctx, unsigned int n) {
652 ctx->K.sp -= n;
653}
654
655static inline lbm_uint *stack_reserve(eval_context_t *ctx, unsigned int n) {
656 if (ctx->K.sp + n < ctx->K.size) {
657 lbm_uint *ptr = &ctx->K.data[ctx->K.sp];
658 ctx->K.sp += n;
659 return ptr;
660 }
661 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_STACK_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x27) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
662}
663
664static void handle_flash_status(lbm_flash_status s) {
665 if ( s == LBM_FLASH_FULL) {
666 lbm_set_error_reason((char*)lbm_error_str_flash_full);
667 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR)error_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
668 }
669 if (s == LBM_FLASH_WRITE_ERROR) {
670 lbm_set_error_reason((char*)lbm_error_str_flash_error);
671 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
672 }
673}

675static void lift_array_flash(lbm_value flash_cell, bool_Bool bytearray, char *data, lbm_uint num_elt) {
676
677 lbm_array_header_t flash_array_header;
678 flash_array_header.size = num_elt;

681 handle_flash_status(lbm_write_const_raw((lbm_uint*)&flash_array_header,
682 sizeof(lbm_array_header_t) / sizeof(lbm_uint),
683 &flash_array_header_ptr));
684 handle_flash_status(write_const_car(flash_cell, flash_array_header_ptr));
685 lbm_uint t = bytearray ? ENC_SYM_ARRAY_TYPE(((0x30) << 4) | 0x00000000u) : ENC_SYM_LISPARRAY_TYPE(((0x39) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
686 handle_flash_status(write_const_cdr(flash_cell, t));
687}

689// ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
690// get_car and lbm_car
691
692// lbm_car is a lower level operation that extracts a car field from a cons cell
693// without any consideration of any additional type-tags associated with the cell.
694// get_car is for list cons-cells only.
695
696static inline void get_car_and_cdr(lbm_value a, lbm_value *a_car, lbm_value *a_cdr) {
697 if (lbm_is_cons(a)) {
698 lbm_cons_t *cell = lbm_ref_cell(a);
699 *a_car = cell->car;
700 *a_cdr = cell->cdr;
701 } else if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(a)) {
702 *a_car = *a_cdr = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
703 } else {
704 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_TERROR)error_ctx((((0x21) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
705 }
706}
707
708/* car cdr caar cadr replacements that are evaluator safe. */
709static inline lbm_value get_car(lbm_value a) {
710 if (lbm_is_cons(a)) {
711 lbm_cons_t *cell = lbm_ref_cell(a);
712 return cell->car;
713 } else if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(a)) {
714 return a;
715 }
716 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_TERROR)error_ctx((((0x21) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
717}
718
719static inline lbm_value get_cdr(lbm_value a) {
720 if (lbm_is_cons(a)) {
721 lbm_cons_t *cell = lbm_ref_cell(a);
722 return cell->cdr;
723 } else if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(a)) {
724 return a;
725 }
726 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_TERROR)error_ctx((((0x21) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
727}
728
729static inline lbm_value get_cadr(lbm_value a) {
730 if (lbm_is_cons(a)) {
731 lbm_cons_t *cell = lbm_ref_cell(a);
732 lbm_value tmp = cell->cdr;
733 if (lbm_is_cons(tmp)) {
734 return lbm_ref_cell(tmp)->car;
735 } else if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(tmp)) {
736 return tmp;
737 }
738 } else if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(a)) {
739 return a;
740 }
741 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_TERROR)error_ctx((((0x21) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
742}

744// Allocate a binding and attach it to a list (if so desired)
745static lbm_value allocate_binding(lbm_value key, lbm_value val, lbm_value the_cdr) {
746#ifdef LBM_ALWAYS_GC
747 lbm_gc_mark_phase(key);
748 lbm_gc_mark_phase(val);
749 lbm_gc_mark_phase(the_cdr);
750 gc();
751 if (lbm_heap_num_free() < 2) {
752 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_MERROR)error_ctx((((0x23) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
753 }
754#else
755 if (lbm_heap_num_free() < 2) {
756 lbm_gc_mark_phase(key);
757 lbm_gc_mark_phase(val);
758 lbm_gc_mark_phase(the_cdr);
759 gc();
760 if (lbm_heap_num_free() < 2) {
761 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_MERROR)error_ctx((((0x23) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
762 }
763 }
764#endif
765 // If num_free is calculated correctly, freelist is definitely a cons-cell.
766 lbm_cons_t* heap = lbm_heap_state.heap;
767 lbm_value binding_cell = lbm_heap_state.freelist;
768 lbm_uint binding_cell_ix = lbm_dec_ptr(binding_cell);
769 lbm_value list_cell = heap[binding_cell_ix].cdr;
770 lbm_uint list_cell_ix = lbm_dec_ptr(list_cell);
771 lbm_heap_state.freelist = heap[list_cell_ix].cdr;
772 lbm_heap_state.num_free -= 2;
773 heap[binding_cell_ix].car = key;
774 heap[binding_cell_ix].cdr = val;
775 heap[list_cell_ix].car = binding_cell;
776 heap[list_cell_ix].cdr = the_cdr;
777 return list_cell;
778}

792// block_current_ctx blocks a context until it is
793// woken up externally or a timeout period of time passes.
794// Blocking while in an atomic block would have bad consequences.
795static void block_current_ctx(uint32_t state, lbm_uint sleep_us, bool_Bool do_cont) {
796 if (is_atomic) atomic_error();
797 ctx_running->timestamp = lbm_timestamp();
798 ctx_running->sleep_us = sleep_us;
799 ctx_running->state = state;
800 ctx_running->app_cont = do_cont;
801 enqueue_ctx(&blocked, ctx_running);
802 ctx_running = NULL((void*)0);
803}
804
805// reblock an essentially already blocked context.
806// Same as block but sets no new timestamp or sleep_us.
807static void reblock_current_ctx(uint32_t state, bool_Bool do_cont) {
808 if (is_atomic) atomic_error();
809 ctx_running->state = state;
810 ctx_running->app_cont = do_cont;
811 enqueue_ctx(&blocked, ctx_running);
812 ctx_running = NULL((void*)0);
813}

816lbm_flash_status lbm_write_const_array_padded(uint8_t *data, lbm_uint n, lbm_uint *res) {
817 lbm_uint full_words = n / sizeof(lbm_uint);
818 lbm_uint n_mod = n % sizeof(lbm_uint);
819
820 if (n_mod == 0) { // perfect fit.
821 return lbm_write_const_raw((lbm_uint*)data, full_words, res);
822 } else {
823 lbm_uint last_word = 0;
824 memcpy(&last_word, &data[full_words * sizeof(lbm_uint)], n_mod);
825 if (full_words >= 1) {
826 lbm_flash_status s = lbm_write_const_raw((lbm_uint*)data, full_words, res);
827 if ( s == LBM_FLASH_WRITE_OK) {
828 lbm_uint dummy;
829 s = lbm_write_const_raw(&last_word, 1, &dummy);
830 }
831 return s;
832 } else {
833 return lbm_write_const_raw(&last_word, 1, res);
834 }
835 }
836}

843sizeopt__attribute__((cold, noinline)) void print_env_ll(lbm_value e, char *buf, unsigned int size) {
844 lbm_value curr_l = e;
845 while (lbm_type_of(curr_l) == LBM_TYPE_CONS0x10000000u) {
846 lbm_print_value(buf, (size/2) - 1, lbm_caar(curr_l));
847 lbm_print_value(buf + (size/2),size/2, lbm_cdr(lbm_car(curr_l)));
848 lbm_printf_callback("\t%s = %s\n", buf, buf+(size/2));
849 curr_l = lbm_cdr(curr_l);
850 }
851}
852
853sizeopt__attribute__((cold, noinline)) void print_environments(char *buf, unsigned int size) {
854
855 lbm_printf_callback("\tCurrent local environment:\n");
856 print_env_ll(ctx_running->curr_env, buf, size);
857 lbm_printf_callback("\n\n\tCurrent global environment:\n");
858 lbm_value *glob_env = lbm_get_global_env();
859 for (int i = 0; i < GLOBAL_ENV_ROOTS32; i ++) {
860 print_env_ll(glob_env[i], buf, size);
861 }
862}

864sizeopt__attribute__((cold, noinline)) void print_error_value(char *buf, uint32_t bufsize, char *pre, lbm_value v, bool_Bool lookup) {
865
866 lbm_print_value(buf, bufsize, v);
867 lbm_printf_callback("%s %s\n",pre, buf);
868 if (lookup) {
869 if (lbm_is_symbol(v)) {
870 if (lbm_dec_sym(v) >= RUNTIME_SYMBOLS_START0x40000) {
871 lbm_value res = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
872 if (lbm_env_lookup_b(&res, v, ctx_running->curr_env) ||
873 lbm_global_env_lookup(&res, v)) {
874 lbm_print_value(buf, bufsize, res);
875 lbm_printf_callback(" bound to: %s\n", buf);
876 } else {
877 lbm_printf_callback(" UNDEFINED\n");
878 }
879 }
880 }
881 }
882}
883
884sizeopt__attribute__((cold, noinline)) static void print_error_message(lbm_value error,
885 bool_Bool has_at,
886 lbm_value at,
887 unsigned int row,
888 unsigned int col,
889 lbm_int row0,
890 lbm_int row1,
891 lbm_int cid,
892 char *name,
893 bool_Bool trapped) {
894 /* try to allocate a lbm_print_value buffer on the lbm_memory */
895 char *buf = lbm_malloc_reserve(ERROR_MESSAGE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES256);
896 if (!buf) {
897 lbm_printf_callback("Error: Not enough memory to show a human readable error message\n");
898 return;
899 }
900 if (trapped) {
901 print_error_value(buf, ERROR_MESSAGE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES256," Error (trapped):", error, false0);
902 } else {
903 print_error_value(buf, ERROR_MESSAGE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES256," Error:", error, false0);
904 }
905 if (lbm_is_symbol_merror(error)) {
906 lbm_printf_callback("\n Heap cells free: %d\n", lbm_heap_state.num_free);
907 lbm_printf_callback(" Mem longest free: %d\n\n", lbm_memory_longest_free());
908 }
909 if (name) {
910 lbm_printf_callback( " CTX: %d \"%s\"\n", cid, name);
911 } else {
912 lbm_printf_callback( " CTX: %d\n", cid);
913 }
914 print_error_value(buf, ERROR_MESSAGE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES256," Current:", ctx_running->curr_exp, true1);
915 // An error can have both a set suspect that can be more detailed than the "at"
916 // show both if present!
917 if (lbm_error_has_suspect) {
918 print_error_value(buf, ERROR_MESSAGE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES256," At:", lbm_error_suspect, true1);
919 lbm_error_has_suspect = false0;
920 }
921 // TODO: Should perhaps be called has_in and be meant to capture a bit
922 // of the surrounding of where the error happened.
923 if (has_at) {
924 print_error_value(buf, ERROR_MESSAGE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES256," In:", at, true1);
925 }
926
927 lbm_printf_callback("\n");
928
929 if (lbm_is_symbol(error) &&
930 error == ENC_SYM_RERROR(((0x20) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
931 lbm_printf_callback(" Line: %u\n", row);
932 lbm_printf_callback(" Column: %u\n", col);
933 } else if (row0 >= 0) {
934 if (row1 < 0) lbm_printf_callback(" Starting at row: %d\n", row0);
935 else lbm_printf_callback(" Between row %d and %d\n", row0, row1);
936 }
937
938 lbm_printf_callback("\n");
939
940 if (ctx_running->error_reason) {
941 lbm_printf_callback(" Reason: %s\n\n", ctx_running->error_reason);
942 }
943 if (lbm_verbose) {
944 lbm_print_value(buf, ERROR_MESSAGE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES256, ctx_running->r);
945 lbm_printf_callback(" Current intermediate result: %s\n\n", buf);
946
947 print_environments(buf, ERROR_MESSAGE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES256);
948
949 lbm_printf_callback("\n Mailbox:\n");
950 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < ctx_running->num_mail; i ++) {
951 lbm_print_value(buf, ERROR_MESSAGE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES256, ctx_running->mailbox[i]);
952 lbm_printf_callback(" %s\n", buf);
953 }
954 lbm_printf_callback("\n Stack:\n");
955 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < ctx_running->K.sp; i ++) {
956 lbm_print_value(buf, ERROR_MESSAGE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES256, ctx_running->K.data[i]);
957 lbm_printf_callback(" %s\n", buf);
958 }
959 }
960 lbm_free(buf);
961}

1048// //////////////////////////////////////////////////
1049// If CID was a type that is impossible to create
1050// other than by "spawning a thread", we could
1051// make direct use of the fact that it is an index into
1052// lbm_memory that identifies a context.
1053// We would still need to ensure by inspection
1054// that the value stored is a context.
1055//
1056// Currently any access to a context via its CID is
1057// done by searching all queues for the context and then modifying it.
1058// This is a SAFE way of accessing the context as it enables
1059// detection of state CID.
1060//
1061// Alternative: A CID should be a heap cell (context_address . symbol)
1062// where no program can generate symbol and the type of (context_address . symbol)
1063// is LBM_TYPE_CID.
1064// This would cost one heap cell per context but, it would
1065// give O(1) lookup of context structure which
1066// is useful in for example message delivery.
1067
1068static eval_context_t *lookup_ctx_nm(eval_context_queue_t *q, lbm_cid cid) {
1069 eval_context_t *curr;
1070 curr = q->first;
1071 while (curr != NULL((void*)0)) {
1072 if (curr->id == cid) {
1073 return curr;
1074 }
1075 curr = curr->next;
1076 }
1077 return NULL((void*)0);
1078}
1079
1080static eval_context_t *lookup_ctx_name_nm(eval_context_queue_t *q, char *name, lbm_uint name_len) {
1081 eval_context_t *curr;
1082 curr = q->first;
1083 while (curr != NULL((void*)0)) {
1084 if (curr->name && strncmp(curr->name, name, name_len) == 0) {
1085 return curr;
1086 }
1087 curr = curr->next;
1088 }
1089 return NULL((void*)0);
1090}

1092
1093// Unlinks a context from a queue (doubly linked list).
1094// Unlinking must be preceded by a lookup, both within the same
1095// lock of a mutex.
1096static void unlink_ctx_nm(eval_context_queue_t *q, eval_context_t *ctx) {
1097
1098 if (ctx->prev == NULL((void*)0)) { // ctx is first in queue
1099 q->first = ctx->next;
1100 } else {
1101 ctx->prev->next = ctx->next;
1102 }
1103
1104 if (ctx->next == NULL((void*)0)) { // ctx is last in queue
1105 q->last = ctx->prev;
1106 } else {
1107 ctx->next->prev = ctx->prev;
1108 }
1109 ctx->next = NULL((void*)0);
1110 ctx->prev = NULL((void*)0);
1111}

1113/* End execution of the running context. */
1114static void finish_ctx(void) {
1115
1116 // Reset atomic status if this finish_ctx is part of an
1117 // untrapper error or a self-kill within an atomic block.
1118 is_atomic = false0;
1119 if (!ctx_running) {
1120 return;
1121 }
1122 if (ctx_running->id == lbm_event_handler_pid) {
1123 lbm_event_handler_pid = -1;
1124 }
1125 /* Drop the continuation stack immediately to free up lbm_memory */
1126 lbm_stack_free(&ctx_running->K);
1127 ctx_done_callback(ctx_running);
1128
1129 lbm_free(ctx_running->name); //free name if in LBM_MEM
1130
1131 lbm_memory_free((lbm_uint*)ctx_running->error_reason); //free error_reason if in LBM_MEM
1132
1133 lbm_memory_free((lbm_uint*)ctx_running->mailbox);
1134 lbm_memory_free((lbm_uint*)ctx_running);
1135 ctx_running = NULL((void*)0);
1136}

1159sizeopt__attribute__((cold, noinline)) static noreturn__attribute__ ((__noreturn__)) void error_ctx_base(lbm_value err_val, bool_Bool has_at, lbm_value at, unsigned int row, unsigned int column) {

1166 (ctx_running->flags & EVAL_CPS_CONTEXT_FLAG_TRAP_UNROLL_RETURN(uint32_t)0x10))) {

1177 );

1179#ifdef LBM_USE_ERROR_LINENO

1182 }
1183#endif

1185 if (lbm_heap_num_free() < 3) {

1187 }
1188
1189 if (lbm_heap_num_free() >= 3) {
1190 lbm_value msg = lbm_cons(err_val, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
1191 msg = lbm_cons(lbm_enc_i(ctx_running->id), msg);
1192 msg = lbm_cons(ENC_SYM_EXIT_ERROR(((0x3000C) << 4) | 0x00000000u), msg);
1193 if (!lbm_is_symbol_merror(msg)) {
1194 lbm_find_receiver_and_send(ctx_running->parent, msg);
1195 }
1196 }
1197 // context dies.
1198 } else if ((ctx_running->flags & EVAL_CPS_CONTEXT_FLAG_TRAP_UNROLL_RETURN(uint32_t)0x10) &&
1199 (err_val != ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR(((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u))) {
1200 while (ctx_running->K.sp > 0) {
1201 lbm_uint v = ctx_running->K.data[--ctx_running->K.sp];
1202 if (v == EXCEPTION_HANDLER(((45) << 2) | 0xF8000001u)) { // context continues executing.
1203 lbm_value *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx_running, 2);
1204 lbm_set_car(sptr[0], ENC_SYM_EXIT_ERROR(((0x3000C) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
1205 stack_reserve(ctx_running, 1)[0] = EXCEPTION_HANDLER(((45) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
1206 ctx_running->app_cont = true1;
1207 ctx_running->r = err_val;
1208 longjmp(error_jmp_buf, 1);
1209 }
1210 }
1211 err_val = ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR(((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
1212 }
1213 ctx_running->r = err_val;
1214 finish_ctx();
1215 longjmp(error_jmp_buf, 1);
1216}

1257static eval_context_t *dequeue_ctx_nm(eval_context_queue_t *q) {
1258 if (q->last == NULL((void*)0)) {
1259 return NULL((void*)0);
1260 }
1261 // q->first should only be NULL if q->last is.
1262 eval_context_t *res = q->first;
1263
1264 if (q->first == q->last) { // One thing in queue
1265 q->first = NULL((void*)0);
1266 q->last = NULL((void*)0);
1267 } else {
1268 q->first = q->first->next;
1269 q->first->prev = NULL((void*)0);
1270 }
1271 res->prev = NULL((void*)0);
1272 res->next = NULL((void*)0);
1273 return res;
1274}

1276static void wake_up_ctxs_nm(void) {
1277 lbm_uint t_now;
1278 t_now = lbm_timestamp();
1279 eval_context_queue_t *q = &blocked;
1280 eval_context_t *curr = q->first;
1281
1282 while (curr != NULL((void*)0)) {
1283 lbm_uint t_diff;
1284 eval_context_t *next = curr->next;
1285 if (LBM_IS_STATE_WAKE_UP_WAKABLE(curr->state)(curr->state & ((uint32_t)4u | (curr->state & (
(uint32_t)2u | (uint32_t)16u))))) {
1286 if ( curr->timestamp > t_now) {
1287 /* There was an overflow on the counter */
1288#ifndef LBM64
1289 t_diff = (0xFFFFFFFF - curr->timestamp) + t_now;
1290#else
1291 t_diff = (0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF - curr->timestamp) + t_now;
1292#endif
1293 } else {
1294 t_diff = t_now - curr->timestamp;
1295 }
1296
1297 if (t_diff >= curr->sleep_us) {
1298 eval_context_t *wake_ctx = curr;
1299 if (curr == q->last) {
1300 if (curr->prev) {
1301 q->last = curr->prev;
1302 q->last->next = NULL((void*)0);
1303 } else {
1304 q->first = NULL((void*)0);
1305 q->last = NULL((void*)0);
1306 }
1307 } else if (curr->prev == NULL((void*)0)) {
1308 q->first = curr->next;
1309 q->first->prev = NULL((void*)0);
1310 } else {
1311 curr->prev->next = curr->next;
1312 if (curr->next) {
1313 curr->next->prev = curr->prev;
1314 }
1315 }
1316 wake_ctx->next = NULL((void*)0);
1317 wake_ctx->prev = NULL((void*)0);
1318 if (LBM_IS_STATE_TIMEOUT(curr->state)(curr->state & ((uint32_t)2u | (uint32_t)16u))) {
1319 mailbox_add_mail(wake_ctx, ENC_SYM_TIMEOUT(((0xA) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
1320 wake_ctx->r = ENC_SYM_TIMEOUT(((0xA) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
1321 }
1322 wake_ctx->state = LBM_THREAD_STATE_READY(uint32_t)0u;
1323 enqueue_ctx_nm(&queue, wake_ctx);
1324 }
1325 }
1326 curr = next;
1327 }
1328}

1330static void yield_ctx(lbm_uint sleep_us) {

1332 ctx_running->timestamp = lbm_timestamp();
1333 ctx_running->sleep_us = sleep_us;
1334 ctx_running->state = LBM_THREAD_STATE_SLEEPING(uint32_t)4u;
1335 ctx_running->r = ENC_SYM_TRUE(((0x2) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
1336 ctx_running->app_cont = true1;
1337 enqueue_ctx(&blocked,ctx_running);
1338 ctx_running = NULL((void*)0);
1339}

1341static lbm_cid lbm_create_ctx_parent(lbm_value program, lbm_value env, lbm_uint stack_size, lbm_cid parent, uint32_t context_flags, char *name) {
1342

1347 {

1355 lbm_uint roots[2] = {program, env};

1361#ifdef LBM_ALWAYS_GC

1363 lbm_uint roots[2] = {program, env};
1364 lbm_gc_mark_roots(roots, 2);
1365 gc();
1366 }
1367#endif
1368 if (!lbm_stack_allocate(&ctx->K, stack_size)) {
1369 lbm_uint roots[2] = {program, env};
1370 lbm_gc_mark_roots(roots, 2);
1371 gc();
1372 if (!lbm_stack_allocate(&ctx->K, stack_size)) {
1373 lbm_memory_free((lbm_uint*)ctx);

1375 }
1376 }

1378 lbm_value *mailbox = NULL((void*)0);
1379#ifdef LBM_ALWAYS_GC
1380 {
1381 lbm_uint roots[2] = {program, env};
1382 lbm_gc_mark_roots(roots, 2);
1383 gc();
1384 }
1385#endif
1386 mailbox = (lbm_value*)lbm_memory_allocate(EVAL_CPS_DEFAULT_MAILBOX_SIZE10);
1387 if (mailbox == NULL((void*)0)) {
1388 lbm_value roots[2] = {program, env};
1389 lbm_gc_mark_roots(roots,2);
1390 gc();
1391 mailbox = (lbm_value *)lbm_memory_allocate(EVAL_CPS_DEFAULT_MAILBOX_SIZE10);
1392 }
1393 if (mailbox == NULL((void*)0)) {
1394 lbm_stack_free(&ctx->K);
1395 lbm_memory_free((lbm_uint*)ctx);
1396 return -1;
1397 }
1398
1399 // TODO: Limit names to 19 chars + 1 char for 0? (or something similar).
1400 if (name) {
1401 lbm_uint name_len = strlen(name) + 1;
1402#ifdef LBM_ALWAYS_GC
1403 {
1404 lbm_uint roots[2] = {program, env};
1405 lbm_gc_mark_roots(roots, 2);
1406 gc();
1407 }
1408#endif
1409 ctx->name = lbm_malloc(name_len);
1410 if (ctx->name == NULL((void*)0)) {
1411 lbm_value roots[2] = {program, env};
1412 lbm_gc_mark_roots(roots, 2);
1413 gc();
1414 ctx->name = lbm_malloc(name_len);
1415 }
1416 if (ctx->name == NULL((void*)0)) {
1417 lbm_stack_free(&ctx->K);
1418 lbm_memory_free((lbm_uint*)mailbox);
1419 lbm_memory_free((lbm_uint*)ctx);
1420 return -1;
1421 }
1422 memcpy(ctx->name, name, name_len);
1423 } else {
1424 ctx->name = NULL((void*)0);
1425 }
1426
1427 lbm_int cid = lbm_memory_address_to_ix((lbm_uint*)ctx);
1428
1429 ctx->program = lbm_cdr(program);
1430 ctx->curr_exp = lbm_car(program);
1431 ctx->curr_env = env;
1432 ctx->r = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
1433 ctx->error_reason = NULL((void*)0);
1434 ctx->mailbox = mailbox;

1436 ctx->flags = context_flags;

1438 ctx->app_cont = false0;
1439 ctx->timestamp = 0;
1440 ctx->sleep_us = 0;
1441 ctx->state = LBM_THREAD_STATE_READY(uint32_t)0u;
1442 ctx->prev = NULL((void*)0);
1443 ctx->next = NULL((void*)0);
1444

1648bool_Bool find_receiver_and_send(find_receiver_t c, lbm_value msg) {
1649 lbm_mutex_lock(&qmutex);

1660 unlink_ctx_nm(&blocked,found);

1662 enqueue_ctx_nm(&queue,found);

1664 mailbox_add_mail(found, msg);

1667
1668 if (c.by_name) {

1671 found = lookup_ctx_nm(&queue, c.u.cid);
1672 }
1673 if (found) {

1678 /* check the current context */

1681 mailbox_add_mail(ctx_running, msg);

1683 }
1684 } else {
1685 if (ctx_running && ctx_running->id == c.u.cid) {
1686 mailbox_add_mail(ctx_running, msg);
1687 goto find_receiver_end;
1688 }
1689 }
1690 res = false0;
1691 find_receiver_end:
1692 lbm_mutex_unlock(&qmutex);
1693 return res;

1705// a match binder looks like (? x) or (? _) for example.
1706// It is a list of two elements where the first is a ? and the second is a symbol.
1707static inline lbm_value get_match_binder_variable(lbm_value exp) {
1708 lbm_value var = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u); // 0 false
1709 if (lbm_is_cons(exp)) {

1711 lbm_value bt = e_cell->car;
1712 if (bt == ENC_SYM_MATCH_ANY(((0x41) << 4) | 0x00000000u) && lbm_is_cons(e_cell->cdr)) {
1713 var = lbm_ref_cell(e_cell->cdr)->car;
1714 }
1715 }
1716 return var;
1717}

1719/* Pattern matching is currently implemented as a recursive
1720 function and make use of stack relative to the size of
1721 expressions that are being matched. */
1722static bool_Bool match(lbm_value p, lbm_value e, lbm_value *env, int rlevel) {
1723 if (rlevel >= LBM_MAX_C_RECURSION200) return false0;
1724 bool_Bool r;
1725 match_quickpath:
1726 r = false0;
Value stored to 'r' is never read
1727 lbm_value var = get_match_binder_variable(p);
1728 if (var) {
1729#ifdef LBM_ALWAYS_GC
1730 lbm_gc_mark_phase(*env);
1731 gc();
1732#endif
1733 lbm_value ls = lbm_heap_allocate_list_init(2, var, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
1734 if (!lbm_is_ptr(ls)) {
1735 lbm_gc_mark_phase(*env);
1736 gc();
1737 ls = lbm_heap_allocate_list_init(2, var, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
1738 if (!lbm_is_ptr(ls)) {
1739 ERROR_CTX(ls)error_ctx(ls);
1740 }
1741 }
1742 lbm_value c1 = ls;
1743 lbm_value c2 = lbm_cdr(ls);
1744 lbm_set_cdr(c1, e);
1745 lbm_set_car_and_cdr(c2, c1, *env);
1746 *env = c2;
1747 r = true1;
1748 } else if (lbm_is_symbol(p)) {
1749 if (p == ENC_SYM_DONTCARE(((0x9) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) r = true1;
1750 else r = (p == e);
1751 } else if (lbm_is_cons(p) && lbm_is_cons(e) ) {
1752 lbm_cons_t *p_cell = lbm_ref_cell(p);
1753 lbm_cons_t *e_cell = lbm_ref_cell(e);
1754 lbm_value headp = p_cell->car;
1755 lbm_value tailp = p_cell->cdr;
1756 lbm_value heade = e_cell->car;
1757 lbm_value taile = e_cell->cdr;
1758 if (match(headp, heade, env, rlevel+1)) {
1759 p = tailp;
1760 e = taile;
1761 goto match_quickpath;
1762 }
1763 r = false0;
1764 } else {
1765 // TODO: Think about this.
1766 // may be better to pass rlevel here.
1767 r = struct_eq(p, e, 0);
1768 }
1769 return r;
1770}

1772// Find match is not very picky about syntax.
1773// A completely malformed recv form is most likely to
1774// just return no_match.
1775static int find_match(lbm_value plist, lbm_value *earr, lbm_uint num, lbm_value *e, lbm_value *env) {
1776 // A pattern list is a list of pattern, expression lists.
1777 // ( (p1 e1) (p2 e2) ... (pn en))
1778 lbm_value curr_p = plist;
1779 int n = 0;
1780 for (int i = 0; i < (int)num; i ++ ) {
1781 lbm_value curr_e = earr[i];
1782 while (lbm_is_cons(curr_p)) {
1783
1784 lbm_value curr = lbm_ref_cell(curr_p)->car;
1785 lbm_value p0, p1, p2;
1786 EXTRACT(curr, p0)do { if (lbm_is_ptr(curr)) { lbm_cons_t *_cell = lbm_ref_cell
(curr); p0 = _cell->car; curr = _cell->cdr; } else { p0
= (((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u); } } while (0);
1787 EXTRACT(curr, p1)do { if (lbm_is_ptr(curr)) { lbm_cons_t *_cell = lbm_ref_cell
(curr); p1 = _cell->car; curr = _cell->cdr; } else { p1
= (((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u); } } while (0);
1788 EXTRACT_NO_ADVANCE(curr, p2)do { if (lbm_is_ptr(curr)) { lbm_cons_t *_cell = lbm_ref_cell
(curr); p2 = _cell->car; } else { p2 = (((0x0) << 4)
| 0x00000000u); } } while (0);
1789 if (!lbm_is_symbol_nil(p2)) { // A rare syntax check. maybe drop?
1790 lbm_set_error_reason("Incorrect pattern format for recv");
1791 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR,curr)error_at_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u), curr);
1792 }
1793 if (match(p0, curr_e, env, 0)) {
1794 *e = p1;
1795 return n;
1796 }
1797 curr_p = lbm_ref_cell(curr_p)->cdr;
1798 }
1799 curr_p = plist; /* search all patterns against next exp */
1800 n ++;
1801 }
1802 return FM_NO_MATCH-2;

1818static int gc(void) {

1820 ctx_running->state = ctx_running->state | LBM_THREAD_STATE_GC_BIT(uint32_t)(1u << 31);
1821 }
1822
1823 gc_requested = false0;
1824 lbm_gc_state_inc();
1825
1826 // The freelist should generally be NIL when GC runs.
1827 lbm_nil_freelist();
1828 lbm_value *env = lbm_get_global_env();
1829 for (int i = 0; i < GLOBAL_ENV_ROOTS32; i ++) {
1830 lbm_gc_mark_env(env[i]);
1831 }
1832
1833 lbm_mutex_lock(&qmutex); // Lock the queues.
1834 // Any concurrent messing with the queues
1835 // while doing GC cannot possibly be good.
1836 queue_iterator_nm(&queue, mark_context, NULL((void*)0), NULL((void*)0));
1837 queue_iterator_nm(&blocked, mark_context, NULL((void*)0), NULL((void*)0));
1838
1839 if (ctx_running) {
1840 mark_context(ctx_running, NULL((void*)0), NULL((void*)0));
1841 }
1842 lbm_mutex_unlock(&qmutex);
1843
1844 int r = lbm_gc_sweep_phase();
1845 lbm_heap_new_freelist_length();
1846 lbm_memory_update_min_free();
1847
1848 if (ctx_running) {

1850 }
1851 return r;
1852}

1862/* eval_symbol
1863 * There are multiple possible ways a symbol could be "bound".
1864 * 1. there is a mapping symbol -> value in the global env.
1865 * 2. there is a mapping symbol -> value in the local env (ctx->curr_env).
1866 * 3. there is a dynamically loadable value associated with the symbol.
1867 * 4. The symbol is special or associated with an extension,
1868 * in which case it evaluates to itself.
1869 *
1870 * Syntax: any-symbol
1871 *
1872 * Expects: T(ctx->curr_exp) == symbol
1873 *
1874 * cases: 1,2,4
1875 * Produces:
1876 * ctx->r = value bound to symbol
1877 * ctx->app_cont = true
1878 *
1879 * cases: 3
1880 * Produces:
1881 * sp = sp+3
1882 * s[sp-3] = ctx->curr_exp (the symbol to evaluate)
1883 * s[sp-2] = ctx->curr_env
1884 * s[sp-1] = RESUME
1885 * ctx->curr_exp <- read_and_evaluate(dynamic value)
1886 * ctx->curr_env <- NIL

1907 sptr[1] = ctx->curr_env;

2064/* Eval lambda is cheating, a lot! It does this
2065 for performance reasons. The cheats are that
2066 1. When closure is created, a reference to the local env
2067 in which the lambda was evaluated is added to the closure.
2068 Ideally it should have created a list of free variables in the function
2069 and then looked up the values of these creating a new environment.
2070 2. The global env is considered global constant. As there is no copying
2071 of environment bindings into the closure, undefine may break closures.
2072
2073 some obscure programs such as test_setq_local_closure.lisp does not
2074 work properly due to this cheating.
2075 */
2076// (lambda param-list body-exp) -> (closure param-list body-exp env)
2077static void eval_lambda(eval_context_t *ctx) {
2078#ifdef LBM_ALWAYS_GC
2079 gc();
2080#endif
2081 for (int retry = 0; retry < 2; retry ++) {
2082 if (lbm_heap_num_free() >= 4) {
2083 lbm_value clo = lbm_heap_state.freelist;
2084 lbm_value lam = get_cdr(ctx->curr_exp);
2085 lbm_uint ix = lbm_dec_ptr(clo);
2086 lbm_cons_t *heap = lbm_heap_state.heap;
2087 heap[ix].car = ENC_SYM_CLOSURE(((0x10F) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
2088 ix = lbm_dec_ptr(heap[ix].cdr);
2089 get_car_and_cdr(lam, &heap[ix].car, &lam); // params
2090 ix = lbm_dec_ptr(heap[ix].cdr);
2091 get_car_and_cdr(lam, &heap[ix].car, &lam); // body
2092 ix = lbm_dec_ptr(heap[ix].cdr);
2093 heap[ix].car = ctx->curr_env;
2094 lbm_heap_state.freelist = heap[ix].cdr;
2095 heap[ix].cdr = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
2096 lbm_heap_state.num_free-=4;
2097 ctx->r = clo;
2098#ifdef CLEAN_UP_CLOSURES
2099 lbm_uint sym_id = 0;
2100 if (clean_cl_env_symbol) {
2101 lbm_value tail = cons_with_gc(ctx->r, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
2102 lbm_value app = cons_with_gc(clean_cl_env_symbol, tail, tail);
2103 ctx->curr_exp = app;
2104 } else if (lbm_get_symbol_by_name("clean-cl-env", &sym_id)) {
2105 clean_cl_env_symbol = lbm_enc_sym(sym_id);
2106 lbm_value tail = cons_with_gc(ctx->r, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
2107 lbm_value app = cons_with_gc(clean_cl_env_symbol, tail, tail);
2108 ctx->curr_exp = app;
2109 } else {
2110 ctx->app_cont = true1;
2111 }
2112#else
2113 ctx->app_cont = true1;
2114#endif
2115 return;
2116 } else {
2117 gc();
2118 }
2119 }
2120 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_MERROR)error_ctx((((0x23) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
2121}

2581 *

2583 * in `ctx->r`.

2670/**
2671 * @brief Setup application of macro

2674 * `ctx->r`.

2676 * @param args List of the arguments to apply the macro with.
2677 * @param curr_env The environment to re-evaluate the result of the macro
2678 * experssion in.

2680static inline __attribute__ ((always_inline)) void setup_macro(eval_context_t *ctx, lbm_value args, lbm_value curr_env) {
2681 /*
2682 * Perform macro expansion.
2683 * Macro expansion is really just evaluation in an
2684 * environment augmented with the unevaluated expressions passed
2685 * as arguments.

2689 // For EVAL_R, placed here already to protect from GC

2695 lbm_value curr_arg = args;
2696 lbm_value expand_env = curr_env;

2698 lbm_is_cons(curr_arg)) {
2699 lbm_cons_t *param_cell = lbm_ref_cell(curr_param); // already checked that cons.
2700 lbm_cons_t *arg_cell = lbm_ref_cell(curr_arg);
2701 lbm_value car_curr_param = param_cell->car;
2702 lbm_value cdr_curr_param = param_cell->cdr;
2703 lbm_value car_curr_arg = arg_cell->car;
2704 lbm_value cdr_curr_arg = arg_cell->cdr;

2707 lbm_value aug_env = cons_with_gc(entry, expand_env,ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));

2711 curr_arg = cdr_curr_arg;

2715 expand_env = allocate_binding(ENC_SYM_REST_ARGS(((0x30015) << 4) | 0x00000000u), curr_arg, expand_env);
2716 }
2717#endif

2719 /* Two rounds of evaluation is performed.
2720 * First to instantiate the arguments into the macro body.
2721 * Second to evaluate the resulting program.
2722 */
2723
2724 sptr[1] = EVAL_R(((11) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
2725 lbm_value exp = get_cadr(get_cdr(ctx->r));
2726 ctx->curr_exp = exp;
2727 ctx->curr_env = expand_env;
2728}

2737 lbm_value *glob_env = lbm_get_global_env();

2739 if (new_env != ENC_SYM_NOT_FOUND(((0x24) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
2740 glob_env[ix_key] = new_env;

2743 if (lbm_is_symbol(new_env) && new_env == ENC_SYM_NOT_FOUND(((0x24) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {

3095// Map takes a function f and a list ls as arguments.
3096// The function f is applied to each element of ls.
3097//
3098// Normally when applying a function to an argument this happens:
3099// 1. the function is evaluated
3100// 2. the argument is evaluated
3101// 3. the result of evaluating the function is applied to the result of evaluating
3102// the argument.
3103//
3104// When doing (map f arg-list) I assume one means to apply f to each element of arg-list
3105// exactly as those elements are. That is, no evaluation of the argument.
3106// The implementation of map below makes sure that the elements of the arg-list are not
3107// evaluated by wrapping them each in a `quote`.
3108//
3109// Map creates a structure in memory that looks like this (f (quote dummy . nil) . nil).
3110// Then, for each element from arg-list (example a1 ... aN) the object
3111// (f (quote aM . nil) . nil) is created by substituting dummy for an element of the list.
3112// after this substitution the evaluator is fired up to evaluate the entire (f (quote aM . nil) . nil)
3113// structure resulting in an element for the result list.
3114//
3115// Here comes the fun part, if you (map quote arg-list), then the object
3116// (quote (quote aM . nil) . nil) is created and evaluated. Now note that quote just gives back
3117// exactly what you give to it when evaluated.
3118// So (quote (quote aM . nil) . nil) gives you as result (quote aM . nil) and now also note that
3119// this is a list, and a list is really just an address on the heap!
3120// This leads to the very fun behavior that:
3121//
3122// # (map quote '(1 2 3 4))
3123// > ((quote 4) (quote 4) (quote 4) (quote 4))
3124//
3125// A potential fix is to instead of creating the object (f (quote aM . nil) . nil)
3126// we create the object (f var) for some unique var and then extend the environment
3127// for each round of evaluation with a binding var => aM.

3549static void call_fptr(lbm_value (*fptr)(lbm_value *, lbm_uint), lbm_value *args, lbm_uint arg_count, eval_context_t *ctx) {
3550 lbm_value res;
3551#ifdef LBM_ALWAYS_GC
3552 gc();
3553#endif
3554 res = fptr(&args[1], arg_count);
3555 if (lbm_is_error(res)) {
3556 if (lbm_is_symbol_merror(res)) {
3557 gc();
3558 res = fptr(&args[1], arg_count);
3559 }
3560 if (lbm_is_error(res)) {
3561 ERROR_AT_CTX(res, args[0])error_at_ctx(res, args[0]);
3562 }
3563 }
3564 stack_drop(ctx, (unsigned int)arg_count+1);
3565 ctx->app_cont = true1;
3566 ctx->r = res;
3567}

3569/***************************************************/
3570/* Application of function that takes arguments */
3571/* passed over the stack. */
3572
3573static void application(eval_context_t *ctx, lbm_value *fun_args, lbm_uint arg_count) {
3574 /* If arriving here, we know that the fun is a symbol.
3575 * and can be a built in operation or an extension.
3576 */
3577 lbm_value fun = fun_args[0];
3578
3579 lbm_uint fun_val = lbm_dec_sym(fun);
3580 lbm_uint fun_kind = SYMBOL_KIND(fun_val)((fun_val) >> 16);
3581
3582 switch (fun_kind) {
3583 case SYMBOL_KIND_EXTENSION1:
3584 call_fptr(extension_table[SYMBOL_IX(fun_val)((fun_val) & 0xFFFF)].fptr, fun_args, arg_count, ctx);
3585 if (blocking_extension) {
3586 blocking_extension = false0;
3587 if (is_atomic) {
3588 // Check atomic_error explicitly so that the mutex
3589 // can be released if there is an error.
3590 lbm_mutex_unlock(&blocking_extension_mutex);
3591 atomic_error();
3592 }
3593 if (blocking_extension_timeout) {
3594 blocking_extension_timeout = false0;
3595 block_current_ctx(LBM_THREAD_STATE_TIMEOUT(uint32_t)2u, blocking_extension_timeout_us,true1);
3596 } else {
3597 block_current_ctx(LBM_THREAD_STATE_BLOCKED(uint32_t)1u, 0,true1);
3598 }
3599 lbm_mutex_unlock(&blocking_extension_mutex);
3600 }
3601 break;
3602 case SYMBOL_KIND_FUNDAMENTAL2:
3603 call_fptr(fundamental_table[SYMBOL_IX(fun_val)((fun_val) & 0xFFFF)], fun_args, arg_count, ctx);
3604 break;
3605 case SYMBOL_KIND_APPFUN3:
3606 fun_table[SYMBOL_IX(fun_val)((fun_val) & 0xFFFF)](&fun_args[1], arg_count, ctx);
3607 break;
3608 default:
3609 // Symbols that are "special" but not in the way caught above
3610 // ends up here.
3611 lbm_set_error_reason("Symbol does not represent a function");
3612 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR,fun_args[0])error_at_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u), fun_args[0]
);
3613 break;
3614 }
3615}

3617// cont_cloure_application_args
3618//
3619// s[sp-5] = environment to evaluate the args in.
3620// s[sp-4] = body
3621// s[sp-3] = closure environment
3622// s[sp-2] = parameter list (Guaranteed cons cell)

3626static void cont_closure_application_args(eval_context_t *ctx) {
3627 lbm_uint* sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 5);
3628
3629 // Not naming these (arg_env, exp, clo_env) may seem like
3630 // poor programming practice, but has a measureable effect on performance on STM32F4.
3631 // Possible reasons:
3632 // - Minute difference in register pressure.
3633 // - Difficulty optimizing across function calls with unknown behavior (unless the compiler
3634 // would analyze it) in relation to the context stack.
3635
3636 //lbm_value arg_env = (lbm_value)sptr[0];
3637 //lbm_value exp = (lbm_value)sptr[1];
3638 //lbm_value clo_env = (lbm_value)sptr[2];
3639 lbm_value params = (lbm_value)sptr[3];
3640 lbm_value args = (lbm_value)sptr[4];
3641
3642 lbm_cons_t *params_cell = lbm_ref_cell(params);
3643
3644 lbm_value binder = allocate_binding(params_cell->car, ctx->r, sptr[2]);
3645
3646 if (lbm_is_cons(args)) { // There are args
3647 lbm_cons_t *args_cell = lbm_ref_cell(args);
3648
3649 // params_cell->cdr is programmer entered syntax, we need to check if a cons
3650 if (lbm_is_cons(params_cell->cdr)) {
3651 sptr[2] = binder;
3652 sptr[3] = params_cell->cdr; // Guaranteed cons cell here
3653 sptr[4] = args_cell->cdr; // Possibly NIL
3654 stack_reserve(ctx,1)[0] = CLOSURE_ARGS(((13) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
3655 } else { // Args but no params => REST_ARGS
3656 lbm_value rest_binder = allocate_binding(ENC_SYM_REST_ARGS(((0x30015) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), binder);
3657 sptr[2] = rest_binder;
3658 sptr[3] = args_cell->cdr;
3659 sptr[4] = get_car(rest_binder); // last element of rest_args so far
3660 stack_reserve(ctx,1)[0] = CLOSURE_ARGS_REST(((42) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
3661 }
3662 ctx->curr_exp = args_cell->car;
3663 ctx->curr_env = sptr[0]; //arg_env;
3664 } else { // No args
3665 if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(params_cell->cdr)) { // No Parameters
3666 stack_drop(ctx, 5);
3667 ctx->curr_env = binder;
3668 ctx->curr_exp = sptr[1]; //exp;
3669 } else { // Not enough arguments
3670 lbm_set_error_reason((char*)lbm_error_str_num_args);
3671 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR)error_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
3672 }
3673 }
3674}

3676// cont_closure_args_rest
3677//
3678// s[sp-5] = environment to evaluate args in
3679// s[sp-4] = body
3680// s[sp-3] = closure environment
3681// s[sp-2] = argument list
3682// s[sp-1] = last cell in rest-args list so far.
3683static void cont_closure_args_rest(eval_context_t *ctx) {
3684 lbm_uint* sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 5);
3685 lbm_value arg_env = (lbm_value)sptr[0];
3686 lbm_value exp = (lbm_value)sptr[1];
3687 lbm_value clo_env = (lbm_value)sptr[2];
3688 lbm_value args = (lbm_value)sptr[3];
3689 lbm_value last = (lbm_value)sptr[4];
3690 lbm_cons_t* heap = lbm_heap_state.heap;
3691#ifdef LBM_ALWAYS_GC
3692 gc();
3693#endif
3694 lbm_value binding = lbm_heap_state.freelist;
3695 if (binding == ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
3696 gc();
3697 binding = lbm_heap_state.freelist;
3698 if (binding == ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_MERROR)error_ctx((((0x23) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
3699 }
3700 lbm_uint binding_ix = lbm_dec_ptr(binding);
3701 lbm_heap_state.freelist = heap[binding_ix].cdr;
3702 lbm_heap_state.num_free -= 1;
3703 heap[binding_ix].car = ctx->r;
3704 heap[binding_ix].cdr = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
3705
3706 lbm_set_cdr(last, binding);
3707 sptr[4] = binding;
3708
3709 if (args == ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
3710 stack_drop(ctx, 5);
3711 ctx->curr_env = clo_env;
3712 ctx->curr_exp = exp;
3713 } else {
3714 stack_reserve(ctx,1)[0] = CLOSURE_ARGS_REST(((42) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
3715 sptr[3] = get_cdr(args);
3716 ctx->curr_exp = get_car(args);
3717 ctx->curr_env = arg_env;
3718 }
3719}

3722// cont_application_args
3723// Functions that take arguments passed on the stack, fundamental and apply_f.
3724//
3725// s[sp-3] = environment to evaluate arguments in.
3726// s[sp-2] = argument list (user input syntax)
3727// s[sp-1] = count
3728//
3729// ctx->r = function
3730static void cont_application_args(eval_context_t *ctx) {
3731 lbm_uint *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 3);
3732
3733 lbm_value env = sptr[0];
3734 lbm_value rest = sptr[1];
3735 lbm_value count = sptr[2];
3736
3737 ctx->curr_env = env;
3738 sptr[0] = ctx->r; // Function 1st then Arguments
3739 if (lbm_is_cons(rest)) { // rest is user input syntax, expensive check needed
3740 lbm_cons_t *cell = lbm_ref_cell(rest);
3741 sptr[1] = env;
3742 sptr[2] = cell->cdr;
3743 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx,2);
3744 rptr[0] = count + (1 << LBM_VAL_SHIFT4); // arithmetic on encoded value
3745 rptr[1] = APPLICATION_ARGS(((5) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
3746 ctx->curr_exp = cell->car;
3747 } else { // tollerant for incorrect list termination.
3748 // No more arguments
3749 stack_drop(ctx, 2);
3750 lbm_uint nargs = lbm_dec_u(count);
3751 lbm_value *args = get_stack_ptr(ctx, (uint32_t)(nargs + 1));
3752 application(ctx,args, nargs);
3753 }
3754}

3802static void fill_binding_location(lbm_value key, lbm_value value, lbm_value env) {
3803 if (lbm_type_of(key) == LBM_TYPE_SYMBOL0x00000000u) {
3804 // NILs dual role makes it hard to detect the difference
3805 // between the end of a structural key or an attempt to use NIL as the key
3806 // or as part of big key.
3807 // NIL has been given the same role as dont care.
3808 if (lbm_dec_sym(key) >= RUNTIME_SYMBOLS_START0x40000) {
3809 lbm_env_modify_binding(env,key,value);
3810 } else {
3811 if (key == ENC_SYM_DONTCARE(((0x9) << 4) | 0x00000000u) || key == ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) return;
3812 lbm_set_error_reason((char*)lbm_error_str_built_in);
3813 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR, key)error_at_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u), key);
3814 }
3815 } else if (lbm_is_cons(key) &&
3816 lbm_is_cons(value)) {
3817 fill_binding_location(lbm_ref_cell(key)->car, lbm_ref_cell(value)->car, env);
3818 fill_binding_location(lbm_ref_cell(key)->cdr, lbm_ref_cell(value)->cdr, env);
3819 } else {
3820 lbm_set_error_reason("Incorrect type of key in binding");
3821 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_TERROR, key)error_at_ctx((((0x21) << 4) | 0x00000000u), key);
3822 }
3823}

(0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u); } } while (0);

4041 // "a" should be moved to the last element position in merged list.
4042 // A new element from "a_rest" should be moved into comparator argument 1 pos.
4043 // else
4044 // "b" should be moved to last element position in merged list.
4045 // A new element from "b_rest" should be moved into comparator argument 2 pos.

4048 // we are done, the remaining elements of
4049 // non_nil list should be appended to merged list.

4051 // Set up for a new comparator evaluation and recurse.
4052 lbm_value a = sptr[2];

4120// merge_layer stack contents
4121// s[sp-9] = cmp
4122// s[sp-8] = cmp_env
4123// s[sp-7] = par1
4124// s[sp-6] = par2
4125// s[sp-5] = acc - first cell
4126// s[sp-4] = acc - last cell
4127// s[sp-3] = rest;
4128// s[sp-2] = layer
4129// s[sp-1] = length or original list
4130//
4131// ctx->r merged sublist
4132static void cont_merge_layer(eval_context_t *ctx) {
4133 lbm_uint *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 9);
4134 lbm_int layer = lbm_dec_i(sptr[7]);
4135 lbm_int len = lbm_dec_i(sptr[8]);
4136
4137 lbm_value r_curr = ctx->r;
4138 while (lbm_is_cons(r_curr)) {
4139 lbm_value next = lbm_ref_cell(r_curr)->cdr;
4140 if (next == ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
4141 break;
4142 }
4143 r_curr = next;
4144 }
4145
4146 if (sptr[4] == ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
4147 sptr[4] = ctx->r;
4148 sptr[5] = r_curr;
4149 } else {
4150 lbm_set_cdr(sptr[5], ctx->r); // accumulate merged sublists.
4151 sptr[5] = r_curr;
4152 }
4153
4154 lbm_value layer_rest = sptr[6];
4155 // switch layer or done ?
4156 if (layer_rest == ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
4157 if (layer * 2 >= len) {
4158 ctx->r = sptr[4];
4159 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4160 stack_drop(ctx, 9);
4161 return;
4162 } else {
4163 // Setup for merges of the next layer
4164 layer = layer * 2;
4165 sptr[7] = lbm_enc_i(layer);
4166 layer_rest = sptr[4]; // continue on the accumulation of all sublists.
4167 sptr[5] = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
4168 sptr[4] = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
4169 }
4170 }
4171 // merge another sublist based on current layer.
4172 lbm_value a_list = layer_rest;
4173 // build sublist a
4174 lbm_value curr = layer_rest;
4175 for (int i = 0; i < layer-1; i ++) {
4176 if (lbm_is_cons(curr)) {
4177 curr = lbm_ref_cell(curr)->cdr;
4178 } else {
4179 break;
4180 }
4181 }
4182 layer_rest = lbm_cdr(curr);
4183 lbm_set_cdr(curr, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u)); //terminate sublist.
4184
4185 lbm_value b_list = layer_rest;
4186 // build sublist b
4187 curr = layer_rest;
4188 for (int i = 0; i < layer-1; i ++) {
4189 if (lbm_is_cons(curr)) {
4190 curr = lbm_ref_cell(curr)->cdr;
4191 } else {
4192 break;
4193 }
4194 }
4195 layer_rest = lbm_cdr(curr);
4196 lbm_set_cdr(curr, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u)); //terminate sublist.
4197
4198 sptr[6] = layer_rest;
4199
4200 if (b_list == ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
4201 stack_reserve(ctx,1)[0] = MERGE_LAYER(((41) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4202 ctx->r = a_list;
4203 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4204 return;
4205 }
4206 // Set up for a merge of sublists.
4207
4208 lbm_value a_rest = lbm_cdr(a_list);
4209 lbm_value b_rest = lbm_cdr(b_list);
4210 lbm_value a = a_list;
4211 lbm_value b = b_list;
4212 lbm_set_cdr(a, b);
4213 // Terminating the b list would be incorrect here
4214 // if there was any chance that the environment update below
4215 // performs GC.
4216 lbm_set_cdr(b, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4217
4218 lbm_value cmp_body = sptr[0];
4219 lbm_value cmp_env = sptr[1];
4220 lbm_value par1 = sptr[2];
4221 lbm_value par2 = sptr[3];
4222 // Environment should be preallocated already at this point
4223 // and the operations below should never need GC.
4224 lbm_value new_env0 = lbm_env_set(cmp_env, par1, lbm_car(a));
4225 lbm_value new_env = lbm_env_set(cmp_env, par2, lbm_car(b));
4226 if (lbm_is_symbol(new_env0) || lbm_is_symbol(new_env)) {
4227 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4228 }
4229 cmp_env = new_env;
4230
4231 lbm_uint *merge_cont = stack_reserve(ctx, 11);
4232 merge_cont[0] = MERGE_LAYER(((41) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4233 merge_cont[1] = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
4234 merge_cont[2] = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
4235 merge_cont[3] = a;
4236 merge_cont[4] = a_rest;
4237 merge_cont[5] = b_rest;
4238 merge_cont[6] = cmp_body;
4239 merge_cont[7] = cmp_env;
4240 merge_cont[8] = par1;
4241 merge_cont[9] = par2;
4242 merge_cont[10] = MERGE_REST(((40) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4243 ctx->curr_exp = cmp_body;
4244 ctx->curr_env = cmp_env;
4245 return;
4246}

4251static void error_on_invalid_read_result(lbm_char_channel_t *str, eval_context_t *ctx) {
4252 if (lbm_is_symbol(ctx->r)) {
4253 lbm_uint sym_val = lbm_dec_sym(ctx->r);
4254 if (sym_val >= TOKENIZER_SYMBOLS_START0x70 &&
4255 sym_val <= TOKENIZER_SYMBOLS_END0x87) {
4256 READ_ERROR_CTX(lbm_channel_row(str), lbm_channel_column(str))read_error_ctx(lbm_channel_row(str), lbm_channel_column(str));
4257 }
4258 }
4259}

4261static void read_finish(lbm_char_channel_t *str, eval_context_t *ctx) {
4262
4263 /* Tokenizer reached "end of file"
4264 The parser could be in a state where it needs
4265 more tokens to correctly finish an expression.
4266
4267 Four cases
4268 1. The program / expression is malformed and the context should die.
4269 2. We are finished reading a program and should close off the
4270 internal representation with a closing parenthesis. Then
4271 apply continuation.
4272 3. We are finished reading an expression and should
4273 apply the continuation
4274 4. We are finished read-and-evaluating
4275
4276 In case 2, we should find the READ_DONE at sp - 4.
4277 In case 3, we should find the READ_DONE at sp - 1.
4278 In case 4, we should find the READ_DONE at sp - 3.
4279
4280 case 3 should not end up here, but rather end up in
4281 cont_read_done.
4282 */
4283
4284 error_on_invalid_read_result(str, ctx);
4285
4286 if (ctx->K.sp > 4 && (ctx->K.data[ctx->K.sp - 3] == READ_DONE(((20) << 2) | 0xF8000001u)) &&
4287 (ctx->K.data[ctx->K.sp - 4] == READING_PROGRAM_INCREMENTALLY((2 << 4) | 0x0000000Cu))) {
4288 /* read and evaluate is done */
4289 --ctx->K.sp; // Pop READ_EVAL_CONTINUE
4290 lbm_value env = ctx->K.data[--ctx->K.sp];
4291 ctx->curr_env = env;
4292 ctx->app_cont = true1; // Program evaluated and result is in ctx->r.
4293 } else if (ctx->K.sp > 5 && (ctx->K.data[ctx->K.sp - 4] == READ_DONE(((20) << 2) | 0xF8000001u)) &&
4294 (ctx->K.data[ctx->K.sp - 5] == READING_PROGRAM((1 << 4) | 0x0000000Cu))) {
4295 /* successfully finished reading a program (CASE 2) */
4296 ctx->r = ENC_SYM_CLOSEPAR(((0x71) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
4297 ctx->app_cont = true1; // Perform the final READ_APPEND_CONTINUE
4298 } else {
4299 if (lbm_channel_row(str) == 1 && lbm_channel_column(str) == 1) {
4300 // (read "") evaluates to nil.
4301 ctx->r = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
4302 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4303 } else {
4304 lbm_channel_reader_close(str);
4305 lbm_set_error_reason((char*)lbm_error_str_parse_eof);
4306 READ_ERROR_CTX(lbm_channel_row(str), lbm_channel_column(str))read_error_ctx(lbm_channel_row(str), lbm_channel_column(str));
4307 }
4308 }
4309}

4521 READ_ERROR_CTX(lbm_channel_row(chan), lbm_channel_column(chan))read_error_ctx(lbm_channel_row(chan), lbm_channel_column(chan
));

4528 /*
4529 * SYMBOL

4532 if (n > 0) {

4544 // and follow a specialised lookup procedure.

4550#endif

4554 ext_name = lbm_malloc(ext_name_len);
4555 }

4560 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_MERROR)error_ctx((((0x23) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4561 }

4565 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4566 }

4568 r = 1;
4569 } else {

4571 }
4572 if (!r) {
4573 READ_ERROR_CTX(lbm_channel_row(chan), lbm_channel_column(chan))read_error_ctx(lbm_channel_row(chan), lbm_channel_column(chan
));
4574 }
4575 }
4576 ctx->r = lbm_enc_sym(symbol_id);

4578 return;
4579 } else if (n == TOKENIZER_NEED_MORE-1) {

4581 } else if (n <= TOKENIZER_STRING_ERROR-2) {
4582 READ_ERROR_CTX(lbm_channel_row(chan), lbm_channel_column(chan))read_error_ctx(lbm_channel_row(chan), lbm_channel_column(chan
));
4583 }
4584
4585 /*
4586 * CHAR
4587 */
4588 char c_val;
4589 n = tok_char(chan, &c_val);
4590 if(n > 0) {
4591 lbm_channel_drop(chan,(unsigned int) n);
4592 ctx->r = lbm_enc_char((uint8_t)c_val);
4593 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4594 return;
4595 }else if (n < 0) goto retry_token;
4596
4597 READ_ERROR_CTX(lbm_channel_row(chan), lbm_channel_column(chan))read_error_ctx(lbm_channel_row(chan), lbm_channel_column(chan
));
4598
4599 retry_token:

4601 stack_reserve(ctx,1)[0] = READ_NEXT_TOKEN(((15) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4602 yield_ctx(EVAL_CPS_MIN_SLEEP200);
4603 return;
4604 }
4605 READ_ERROR_CTX(lbm_channel_row(chan), lbm_channel_column(chan))read_error_ctx(lbm_channel_row(chan), lbm_channel_column(chan
));
4606}

4608static void cont_read_start_bytearray(eval_context_t *ctx) {
4609 lbm_char_channel_t *str = lbm_dec_channel(ctx->reader_stream);
4610 if (str == NULL((void*)0) || str->state == NULL((void*)0)) {
4611 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4612 return; // INFER does not understand that error_ctx longjmps out
4613 // of this function here.

4616 lbm_value array;
4617
4618 if (!lbm_heap_allocate_array(&array, 0)) {
4619 gc();
4620 if (!lbm_heap_allocate_array(&array, 0)) {
4621 lbm_set_error_reason((char*)lbm_error_str_read_no_mem);
4622 lbm_channel_reader_close(str);
4623 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u)); // Terminates ctx
4624 }
4625 }
4626 ctx->r = array;
4627 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4628 } else if (lbm_is_number(ctx->r)) {
4629#ifdef LBM_ALWAYS_GC
4630 gc();
4631#endif
4632 lbm_uint num_free = lbm_memory_longest_free();
4633 lbm_uint initial_size = (lbm_uint)((float)num_free * 0.9);
4634 if (initial_size == 0) {
4635 gc();
4636 num_free = lbm_memory_longest_free();
4637 initial_size = (lbm_uint)((float)num_free * 0.9);
4638 if (initial_size == 0) {
4639 lbm_channel_reader_close(str);
4640 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_MERROR)error_ctx((((0x23) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4641 }
4642 }
4643 lbm_value array;
4644 // lbm_memory should not be large enough
4645 // for this to overflow a 32bit number.
4646 initial_size = sizeof(lbm_uint) * initial_size;
4647
4648 // Keep in mind that this allocation can fail for both
4649 // lbm_memory and heap reasons.
4650 if (!lbm_heap_allocate_array(&array, initial_size)) {
4651 gc();
4652 if (!lbm_heap_allocate_array(&array, initial_size)) {
4653 lbm_set_error_reason((char*)lbm_error_str_read_no_mem);
4654 lbm_channel_reader_close(str);
4655 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4656 // NOTE: If array is not created evaluation ends here.
4657 // Static analysis seems unaware.
4658 }
4659 }
4660
4661
4662 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 4);
4663 rptr[0] = array;
4664 rptr[1] = lbm_enc_u(initial_size);
4665 rptr[2] = lbm_enc_u(0);
4666 rptr[3] = READ_APPEND_BYTEARRAY(((22) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4667 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4668 } else {
4669 lbm_channel_reader_close(str);
4670 READ_ERROR_CTX(lbm_channel_row(str), lbm_channel_column(str))read_error_ctx(lbm_channel_row(str), lbm_channel_column(str));
4671 }
4672}

4674static void cont_read_append_bytearray(eval_context_t *ctx) {
4675 lbm_uint *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 3);
4676
4677 lbm_value array = sptr[0];
4678 lbm_value size = lbm_dec_u(sptr[1]);
4679 lbm_value ix = lbm_dec_u(sptr[2]);
4680
4681 // This is an MERROR because if this comparison
4682 // is true, there is a literal byte array in the code
4683 // and it did not fit into the array we are reading into,
4684 // which is 90% of free memory.
4685 if (ix >= size) {
4686 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_MERROR)error_ctx((((0x23) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4687 }
4688
4689 // if sptr[0] is not an array something is very very wrong.
4690 // Not robust against a garbage on stack. But how would garbage get onto stack?
4691 lbm_array_header_t *arr = assume_array(array);
4692 if (lbm_is_number(ctx->r)) {
4693 ((uint8_t*)arr->data)[ix] = (uint8_t)lbm_dec_as_u32(ctx->r);
4694
4695 sptr[2] = lbm_enc_u(ix + 1);
4696 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 2);
4697 rptr[0] = READ_APPEND_BYTEARRAY(((22) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4698 rptr[1] = READ_NEXT_TOKEN(((15) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4699 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4700 } else if (lbm_is_symbol(ctx->r) && ctx->r == ENC_SYM_CLOSEBRACK(((0x81) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
4701 lbm_uint array_size = ix / sizeof(lbm_uint);
4702
4703 if (ix % sizeof(lbm_uint) != 0) {
4704 array_size = array_size + 1;
4705 }
4706 lbm_memory_shrink((lbm_uint*)arr->data, array_size);
4707 arr->size = ix;
4708 stack_drop(ctx, 3);
4709 ctx->r = array;
4710 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4711 } else {
4712 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_TERROR)error_ctx((((0x21) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4713 }
4714}

4776static void cont_read_append_array(eval_context_t *ctx) {
4777 lbm_uint *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 3);
4778
4779 lbm_value array = sptr[0];
4780 lbm_value size = lbm_dec_as_u32(sptr[1]);
4781 lbm_value ix = lbm_dec_as_u32(sptr[2]);
4782
4783 // This is a MERROR because if this comparison is true
4784 // it means that a literal lisp aray is requireing more that
4785 // 90% of currently free memory. The programmer should
4786 // be informed that her program uses too much memory.
4787 if (ix >= (size / sizeof(lbm_uint))) {
4788 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_MERROR)error_ctx((((0x23) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4789 }
4790
4791 // if sptr[0] is not an array something is very very wrong.
4792 // Not robust against a garbage on stack. But how would garbage get onto stack?
4793 lbm_array_header_t *arr = assume_array(array);
4794 if (lbm_is_symbol(ctx->r) && ctx->r == ENC_SYM_CLOSEARRAY(((0x87) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
4795 lbm_uint array_size = ix;
4796
4797 if (ix % sizeof(lbm_uint) != 0) {
4798 array_size = array_size + 1;
4799 }
4800 lbm_memory_shrink((lbm_uint*)arr->data, array_size);
4801 // Ix is small and ix * sizeof(lbm_uint) will not overflow.
4802 arr->size = ix * sizeof(lbm_uint);
4803 stack_drop(ctx, 3);
4804 ctx->r = array;
4805 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4806 } else {
4807 ((lbm_uint*)arr->data)[ix] = ctx->r;
4808
4809 sptr[2] = lbm_enc_u(ix + 1);
4810 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 2);
4811 rptr[0] = READ_APPEND_ARRAY(((50) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4812 rptr[1] = READ_NEXT_TOKEN(((15) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4813 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4814 }
4815}

4830static void cont_read_append_continue(eval_context_t *ctx) {
4831 lbm_value *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 2);
4832
4833 lbm_value first_cell = sptr[0];
4834 lbm_value last_cell = sptr[1];
4835
4836 lbm_char_channel_t *str = lbm_dec_channel(ctx->reader_stream);
4837 if (str == NULL((void*)0) || str->state == NULL((void*)0)) {
4838 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4839 }
4840
4841 if (lbm_is_symbol(ctx->r)) {
4842 switch(ctx->r) {
4843 case ENC_SYM_CLOSEPAR(((0x71) << 4) | 0x00000000u):
4844 // last_cell is either nil or a rw cons cell.
4845 if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(last_cell)) {
4846 ctx->r = last_cell;
4847 } else {
4848 // Here we know, by the principled use of the stack, that last_cell is a rw cons cell.
4849 lbm_ref_cell(last_cell)->cdr = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
4850 // Could even rewrite as: lbm_heap_state.heap[lbm_dec_ptr(last_cell)].cdr = ENC_SYM_NIL;
4851 ctx->r = first_cell;
4852 }
4853 stack_drop(ctx, 2);
4854 // Skip reading another token and apply the continuation.
4855 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4856 return;
4857 case ENC_SYM_DOT(((0x76) << 4) | 0x00000000u): {
4858 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 2);
4859 rptr[0] = READ_DOT_TERMINATE(((19) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4860 rptr[1] = READ_NEXT_TOKEN(((15) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4861 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4862 } return;
4863 }
4864 }
4865 lbm_value new_cell = cons_with_gc(ctx->r, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4866 // Does not return if merror. So we cannot get a read-error here
4867 // unless we write the a version of cons_with_gc here.
4868 //if (lbm_is_symbol_merror(new_cell)) {
4869 // lbm_channel_reader_close(str);
4870 // read_error_ctx(lbm_channel_row(str), lbm_channel_column(str));
4871 // return;
4872 //}
4873 if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(last_cell)) {
4874 first_cell = last_cell = new_cell;
4875 } else {
4876 lbm_ref_cell(last_cell)->cdr = new_cell;
4877 last_cell = new_cell;
4878 }
4879
4880 sptr[0] = first_cell;
4881 sptr[1] = last_cell;
4882 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 2);
4883 rptr[0] = READ_APPEND_CONTINUE(((16) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4884 rptr[1] = READ_NEXT_TOKEN(((15) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4885 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4886}

4888static void cont_read_eval_continue(eval_context_t *ctx) {
4889 lbm_value env;
4890 lbm_value *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 1);
4891 env = sptr[0];
4892 lbm_char_channel_t *str = lbm_dec_channel(ctx->reader_stream);
4893 if (str && str->state) {
4894 ctx->row1 = (lbm_int)str->row(str);
4895 if (lbm_type_of(ctx->r) == LBM_TYPE_SYMBOL0x00000000u) {
4896 switch(ctx->r) {
4897 case ENC_SYM_CLOSEPAR(((0x71) << 4) | 0x00000000u):
4898 stack_drop(ctx, 1);
4899 ctx->app_cont = true1;
4900 return;
4901 case ENC_SYM_DOT(((0x76) << 4) | 0x00000000u):
4902 // A dot here is a syntax error.

4912 rptr[3] = lbm_enc_u(ctx->flags);
4913 rptr[4] = POP_READER_FLAGS(((44) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
4914
4915 // Evaluate result of reading (in r) and then continue with
4916 // reading reading the rest of the program.
4917 ctx->curr_env = env;
4918 ctx->curr_exp = ctx->r;
4919 } else {
4920 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
4921 }

4997 ctx->r))(cell) = (lbm_heap_allocate_list_init(2, wrapper, ctx->r))
; if (lbm_is_symbol_merror((cell))) { gc(); (cell) = (lbm_heap_allocate_list_init
(2, wrapper, ctx->r)); if (lbm_is_symbol_merror((cell))) {
error_ctx((((0x23) << 4) | 0x00000000u)); } };
4998 ctx->r = cell;
4999 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5000}

5002// cont_application_start
5003//
5004// sptr[0] = env
5005// sptr[1] = args
5006//
5007// ctx->r = function
5008static void cont_application_start(eval_context_t *ctx) {
5009 if (lbm_is_symbol(ctx->r)) {
5010 stack_reserve(ctx,1)[0] = lbm_enc_u(0);
5011 cont_application_args(ctx);
5012 } else if (lbm_is_cons(ctx->r)) {
5013 lbm_uint *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 2);
5014 lbm_value args = (lbm_value)sptr[1];
5015 switch (lbm_ref_cell(ctx->r)->car) { // Already checked that is_cons
5016 case ENC_SYM_CLOSURE(((0x10F) << 4) | 0x00000000u): {
5017 lbm_value cl = lbm_ref_cell(ctx->r)->cdr; // Already checked that is_cons
5018 lbm_value cl0, cl1, cl2;
5019 EXTRACT(cl, cl0)do { if (lbm_is_ptr(cl)) { lbm_cons_t *_cell = lbm_ref_cell(cl
); cl0 = _cell->car; cl = _cell->cdr; } else { cl0 = ((
(0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u); } } while (0); // CLO_PARAMS
5020 EXTRACT(cl, cl1)do { if (lbm_is_ptr(cl)) { lbm_cons_t *_cell = lbm_ref_cell(cl
); cl1 = _cell->car; cl = _cell->cdr; } else { cl1 = ((
(0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u); } } while (0); // CLO_BODY
5021 EXTRACT_NO_ADVANCE(cl, cl2)do { if (lbm_is_ptr(cl)) { lbm_cons_t *_cell = lbm_ref_cell(cl
); cl2 = _cell->car; } else { cl2 = (((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u
); } } while (0); // CLO_ENV
5022 lbm_value arg_env = (lbm_value)sptr[0];
5023
5024 if (lbm_is_cons(args)) { // There are args
5025 lbm_cons_t *args_cell = lbm_ref_cell(args);
5026 sptr[1] = cl1; // WARNING overwrites args on stack. args are unprotected.
5027 if (lbm_is_cons(cl0)) { // There are params
5028 lbm_value *reserved = stack_reserve(ctx, 4);
5029 reserved[0] = cl2;
5030 reserved[1] = cl0; // Guaranteed cons cell here
5031 reserved[2] = args_cell->cdr; // Possibly NIL
5032 reserved[3] = CLOSURE_ARGS(((13) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5033 ctx->curr_exp = args_cell->car;
5034 ctx->curr_env = arg_env;
5035 } else { // args but no params => REST_ARGS
5036 lbm_value *reserved0 = stack_reserve(ctx, 2);
5037 reserved0[0] = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);;
5038 reserved0[1] = args_cell->cdr;
5039 ctx->curr_exp = args_cell->car; // protect car(args) from allocate binding
5040 ctx->curr_env = arg_env;
5041 lbm_value rest_binder = allocate_binding(ENC_SYM_REST_ARGS(((0x30015) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), cl2);
5042 lbm_value *reserved1 = stack_reserve(ctx, 2);
5043 reserved0[0] = rest_binder;
5044 reserved1[0] = get_car(rest_binder);
5045 reserved1[1] = CLOSURE_ARGS_REST(((42) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5046 }
5047 } else { // No args
5048 if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(cl0)) { // No parameters
5049 stack_drop(ctx, 2);
5050 ctx->curr_exp = cl1;
5051 ctx->curr_env = cl2;
5052 } else { // Not enough arguments
5053 lbm_set_error_reason((char*)lbm_error_str_num_args);
5054 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR, ctx->r)error_at_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ctx->r);
5055 }
5056 }
5057 } break;
5058 case ENC_SYM_CONT(((0x10E) << 4) | 0x00000000u):{
5059 ctx->curr_exp = setup_cont(ctx, args);
5060 } break;
5061 case ENC_SYM_CONT_SP(((0x118) << 4) | 0x00000000u): {
5062 ctx->curr_exp = setup_cont_sp(ctx, args);
5063 return;
5064 } break;
5065 case ENC_SYM_MACRO(((0x10D) << 4) | 0x00000000u):{
5066 lbm_value env = (lbm_value)sptr[0];
5067 pop_stack_ptr(ctx, 2);
5068 setup_macro(ctx, args, env);
5069 } break;
5070 default:
5071 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR)error_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5072 }
5073 } else {
5074 lbm_set_error_reason(lbm_error_str_not_applicable);
5075 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR, ctx->r)error_at_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ctx->r);
5076 }
5077}

5104lbm_flash_status request_flash_storage_cell(lbm_value val, lbm_value *res) {
5105
5106 lbm_value flash_cell;
5107 lbm_flash_status s = lbm_allocate_const_cell(&flash_cell);
5108 if (s != LBM_FLASH_WRITE_OK)
5109 return s;
5110 lbm_value new_val = val;
5111 new_val &= ~LBM_PTR_VAL_MASK0x03FFFFFCu; // clear the value part of the ptr
5112 new_val |= (flash_cell & LBM_PTR_VAL_MASK0x03FFFFFCu);
5113 new_val |= LBM_PTR_TO_CONSTANT_BIT0x04000000u;
5114 *res = new_val;
5115 return s;
5116}
5117
5118static void cont_move_to_flash(eval_context_t *ctx) {
5119
5120 lbm_value args = ctx->K.data[--ctx->K.sp];
5121
5122 if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(args)) {
5123 // Done looping over arguments. return true.
5124 ctx->r = ENC_SYM_TRUE(((0x2) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
5125 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5126 return;
5127 }
5128
5129 lbm_value first_arg, rest;
5130 get_car_and_cdr(args, &first_arg, &rest);
5131
5132 lbm_value val;
5133 if (lbm_is_symbol(first_arg) && lbm_global_env_lookup(&val, first_arg)) {
5134 // Prepare to copy the rest of the arguments when done with first.
5135 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 2);
5136 rptr[0] = rest;
5137 rptr[1] = MOVE_TO_FLASH(((28) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5138 if (lbm_is_ptr(val) &&
5139 (!(val & LBM_PTR_TO_CONSTANT_BIT0x04000000u))) {
5140 lbm_value * rptr1 = stack_reserve(ctx, 3);
5141 rptr1[0] = first_arg;
5142 rptr1[1] = SET_GLOBAL_ENV(((1) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5143 rptr1[2] = MOVE_VAL_TO_FLASH_DISPATCH(((29) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5144 ctx->r = val;
5145 }
5146 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5147 return;
5148 }
5149 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR)error_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5150}
5151
5152static void cont_move_val_to_flash_dispatch(eval_context_t *ctx) {
5153
5154 lbm_value val = ctx->r;
5155
5156 if (lbm_is_cons(val)) { // non-constant cons-cell
5157 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 5);
5158 rptr[0] = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u); // fst cell of list
5159 rptr[1] = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u); // last cell of list
5160 rptr[2] = get_cdr(val);
5161 rptr[3] = MOVE_LIST_TO_FLASH(((30) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5162 rptr[4] = MOVE_VAL_TO_FLASH_DISPATCH(((29) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5163 ctx->r = lbm_ref_cell(val)->car; // already checked is_cons
5164 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5165 return;
5166 }
5167
5168 if (lbm_is_ptr(val) && (val & LBM_PTR_TO_CONSTANT_BIT0x04000000u)) { // constant pointer cons or not.
5169 //ctx->r unchanged
5170 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5171 return;
5172 }
5173
5174 if (lbm_is_ptr(val)) { // something that is not a cons but still a ptr type.
5175 lbm_cons_t *ref = lbm_ref_cell(val);
5176 if (lbm_type_of(ref->cdr) == LBM_TYPE_SYMBOL0x00000000u) {
5177 switch (ref->cdr) {
5178 case ENC_SYM_RAW_I_TYPE(((0x31) << 4) | 0x00000000u): /* fall through */
5179 case ENC_SYM_RAW_U_TYPE(((0x32) << 4) | 0x00000000u):
5180 case ENC_SYM_RAW_F_TYPE(((0x33) << 4) | 0x00000000u): {
5181 lbm_value flash_cell = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
5182 handle_flash_status(request_flash_storage_cell(val, &flash_cell));
5183 handle_flash_status(write_const_car(flash_cell, ref->car));
5184 handle_flash_status(write_const_cdr(flash_cell, ref->cdr));
5185 ctx->r = flash_cell;
5186 } break;
5187 case ENC_SYM_IND_I_TYPE(((0x34) << 4) | 0x00000000u): /* fall through */
5188 case ENC_SYM_IND_U_TYPE(((0x35) << 4) | 0x00000000u):
5189 case ENC_SYM_IND_F_TYPE(((0x36) << 4) | 0x00000000u): {
5190#ifndef LBM64
5191 /* 64 bit values are in lbm mem on 32bit platforms. */
5192 lbm_uint *lbm_mem_ptr = (lbm_uint*)ref->car;
5193 lbm_uint flash_ptr;
5194
5195 handle_flash_status(lbm_write_const_raw(lbm_mem_ptr, 2, &flash_ptr));
5196 lbm_value flash_cell = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
5197 handle_flash_status(request_flash_storage_cell(val, &flash_cell));
5198 handle_flash_status(write_const_car(flash_cell, flash_ptr));
5199 handle_flash_status(write_const_cdr(flash_cell, ref->cdr));
5200 ctx->r = flash_cell;
5201#else
5202 // There are no indirect types in LBM64
5203 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5204#endif
5205 } break;
5206 case ENC_SYM_LISPARRAY_TYPE(((0x39) << 4) | 0x00000000u): {
5207 lbm_array_header_t *arr = (lbm_array_header_t*)ref->car;
5208 lbm_uint size = arr->size / sizeof(lbm_uint);
5209 lbm_uint flash_addr = 0;
5210 lbm_value *arrdata = (lbm_value *)arr->data;
5211 lbm_value flash_cell = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
5212 handle_flash_status(request_flash_storage_cell(val, &flash_cell));
5213 handle_flash_status(lbm_allocate_const_raw(size, &flash_addr));
5214 lift_array_flash(flash_cell,
5215 false0,
5216 (char *)flash_addr,
5217 arr->size);
5218 // Move array contents to flash recursively
5219 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 5);
5220 rptr[0] = flash_cell;
5221 rptr[1] = lbm_enc_u(0);
5222 rptr[2] = val;
5223 rptr[3] = MOVE_ARRAY_ELTS_TO_FLASH(((43) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5224 rptr[4] = MOVE_VAL_TO_FLASH_DISPATCH(((29) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5225 ctx->r = arrdata[0];
5226 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5227 return;
5228 }
5229 case ENC_SYM_ARRAY_TYPE(((0x30) << 4) | 0x00000000u): {
5230 lbm_array_header_t *arr = (lbm_array_header_t*)ref->car;
5231 // arbitrary address: flash_arr.
5232 lbm_uint flash_arr = 0;
5233 handle_flash_status(lbm_write_const_array_padded((uint8_t*)arr->data, arr->size, &flash_arr));
5234 lbm_value flash_cell = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
5235 handle_flash_status(request_flash_storage_cell(val, &flash_cell));
5236 lift_array_flash(flash_cell,
5237 true1,
5238 (char *)flash_arr,
5239 arr->size);
5240 ctx->r = flash_cell;
5241 } break;
5242 case ENC_SYM_CHANNEL_TYPE(((0x37) << 4) | 0x00000000u): /* fall through */
5243 case ENC_SYM_CUSTOM_TYPE(((0x38) << 4) | 0x00000000u):
5244 lbm_set_error_reason((char *)lbm_error_str_flash_not_possible);
5245 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR)error_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5246 }
5247 } else {
5248 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_FATAL_ERROR)error_ctx((((0x26) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5249 }
5250 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5251 return;
5252 }
5253
5254 // if no condition matches, nothing happens (id).
5255 ctx->r = val;
5256 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5257}

5259static void cont_move_list_to_flash(eval_context_t *ctx) {
5260
5261 // ctx->r holds the value that should go in car
5262
5263 lbm_value *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 3);
5264
5265 lbm_value fst = sptr[0];
5266 lbm_value lst = sptr[1];
5267 lbm_value val = sptr[2];
5268
5269
5270 lbm_value new_lst = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
5271 // Allocate element ptr storage after storing the element to flash.
5272 handle_flash_status(request_flash_storage_cell(lbm_enc_cons_ptr(LBM_PTR_NULL(0x03FFFFFCu >> 2)), &new_lst));
5273
5274 if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(fst)) {
5275 lst = new_lst;
5276 fst = new_lst;
5277 handle_flash_status(write_const_car(lst, ctx->r));
5278 } else {
5279 handle_flash_status(write_const_cdr(lst, new_lst)); // low before high
5280 handle_flash_status(write_const_car(new_lst, ctx->r));
5281 lst = new_lst;
5282 }
5283
5284 if (lbm_is_cons(val)) {
5285 sptr[0] = fst;
5286 sptr[1] = lst;//rest_cell;
5287 sptr[2] = lbm_ref_cell(val)->cdr;
5288 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 2);
5289 rptr[0] = MOVE_LIST_TO_FLASH(((30) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5290 rptr[1] = MOVE_VAL_TO_FLASH_DISPATCH(((29) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5291 ctx->r = lbm_ref_cell(val)->car; // already checked is_cons
5292 } else {
5293 sptr[0] = fst;
5294 sptr[1] = lst;
5295 sptr[2] = CLOSE_LIST_IN_FLASH(((31) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5296 stack_reserve(ctx, 1)[0] = MOVE_VAL_TO_FLASH_DISPATCH(((29) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5297 ctx->r = val;
5298 }
5299 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5300}

5302static void cont_close_list_in_flash(eval_context_t *ctx) {

5304 lbm_value fst = ctx->K.data[--ctx->K.sp];
5305 lbm_value val = ctx->r;

5307 ctx->r = fst;
5308 ctx->app_cont = true1;
