5311static void cont_move_array_elts_to_flash(eval_context_t *ctx) {
5312 lbm_value *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 3);
5313 // sptr[2] = source array in RAM
5314 // sptr[1] = current index
5315 // sptr[0] = target array in flash
5316 lbm_array_header_t *src_arr = assume_array(sptr[2]);
5317 lbm_uint size = src_arr->size / sizeof(lbm_uint);
5318 lbm_value *srcdata = (lbm_value *)src_arr->data;
5319
5320 lbm_array_header_t *tgt_arr = assume_array(sptr[0]);
5321 lbm_uint *tgtdata = (lbm_value *)tgt_arr->data;
5322 lbm_uint ix = lbm_dec_as_u32(sptr[1]);
5323 handle_flash_status(lbm_const_write(&tgtdata[ix], ctx->r));
5324 if (ix >= size-1) {
5325 ctx->r = sptr[0];
5326 stack_drop(ctx, 3);
5327 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5328 return;
5329 }
5330 sptr[1] = lbm_enc_u(ix + 1);
5331 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 2);
5332 rptr[0] = MOVE_ARRAY_ELTS_TO_FLASH(((43) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5333 rptr[1] = MOVE_VAL_TO_FLASH_DISPATCH(((29) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5334 ctx->r = srcdata[ix+1];
5335 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5336 return;
5337}

5341 rptr[0] = ctx->r;
5342 rptr[1] = QQ_EXPAND(((33) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);

5347static lbm_value quote_it(lbm_value qquoted) {
5348 if (lbm_is_symbol(qquoted) &&
5349 lbm_is_special(qquoted)) return qquoted;
5350
5351 lbm_value val = cons_with_gc(qquoted, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5352 return cons_with_gc(ENC_SYM_QUOTE(((0x100) << 4) | 0x00000000u), val, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5353}
5354
5355static bool_Bool is_append(lbm_value a) {
5356 return (lbm_is_cons(a) &&
5357 lbm_is_symbol(lbm_ref_cell(a)->car) &&
5358 (lbm_ref_cell(a)->car == ENC_SYM_APPEND(((0x20015) << 4) | 0x00000000u)));
5359}
5360
5361static lbm_value append(lbm_value front, lbm_value back) {
5362 if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(front)) return back;
5363 if (lbm_is_symbol_nil(back)) return front;
5364
5365 if (lbm_is_quoted_list(front) &&
5366 lbm_is_quoted_list(back)) {
5367 lbm_value f = get_cadr(front);
5368 lbm_value b = get_cadr(back);
5369 return quote_it(lbm_list_append(f, b));
5370 }
5371
5372 if (is_append(back) &&
5373 lbm_is_quoted_list(get_cadr(back)) &&
5374 lbm_is_quoted_list(front)) {
5375 lbm_value ql = get_cadr(back);
5376 lbm_value f = get_cadr(front);
5377 lbm_value b = get_cadr(ql);
5378
5379 lbm_value v = lbm_list_append(f, b);
5380 lbm_set_car(get_cdr(ql), v);
5381 return back;
5382 }
5383
5384 if (is_append(back)) {
5385 back = get_cdr(back);
5386 lbm_value new = cons_with_gc(front, back, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5387 return cons_with_gc(ENC_SYM_APPEND(((0x20015) << 4) | 0x00000000u), new, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5388 }
5389
5390 lbm_value t0, t1;
5391
5392 t0 = cons_with_gc(back, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), front);
5393 t1 = cons_with_gc(front, t0, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5394 return cons_with_gc(ENC_SYM_APPEND(((0x20015) << 4) | 0x00000000u), t1, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5395}
5396
5397// ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
5398// Quasiquotation expansion that takes place at read time
5399// and is based on the paper by Bawden "Quasiquotation in lisp".
5400// Bawden, Alan. "Quasiquotation in Lisp." PEPM. 1999.
5401//
5402// cont_qq_expand and cont_qq_expand_list corresponds (mostly) to
5403// qq-expand and qq-expand-list in the paper.
5404// One difference is that the case where a backquote is nested
5405// inside of a backqoute is handled via the recursion through the
5406// reader.
5407
5408/* Bawden's qq-expand implementation
5409(define (qq-expand x)
5410 (cond ((tag-comma? x)
5411 (tag-data x))
5412 ((tag-comma-atsign? x)
5413 (error "Illegal"))
5414 ((tag-backquote? x)
5415 (qq-expand
5416 (qq-expand (tag-data x))))
5417 ((pair? x)
5418 `(append
5419 ,(qq-expand-list (car x))
5420 ,(qq-expand (cdr x))))
5421 (else `',x)))
5422 */
5423static void cont_qq_expand(eval_context_t *ctx) {
5424 lbm_value qquoted = ctx->K.data[--ctx->K.sp];
5425
5426 switch(lbm_type_of(qquoted)) {
5427 case LBM_TYPE_CONS0x10000000u: {
5428 lbm_value car_val;
5429 lbm_value cdr_val;
5430 get_car_and_cdr(qquoted, &car_val, &cdr_val);
5431
5432 if (lbm_type_of(car_val) == LBM_TYPE_SYMBOL0x00000000u &&
5433 car_val == ENC_SYM_COMMA(((0x73) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
5434 ctx->r = append(ctx->r, get_car(cdr_val));
5435 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5436 } else if (lbm_type_of(car_val) == LBM_TYPE_SYMBOL0x00000000u &&
5437 car_val == ENC_SYM_COMMAAT(((0x74) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
5438 lbm_set_error_reason((char*)lbm_error_str_qq_expand);
5439 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_RERROR, qquoted)error_at_ctx((((0x20) << 4) | 0x00000000u), qquoted);
5440 } else {
5441 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 6);
5442 rptr[0] = ctx->r;
5443 rptr[1] = QQ_APPEND(((34) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5444 rptr[2] = cdr_val;
5445 rptr[3] = QQ_EXPAND(((33) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5446 rptr[4] = car_val;
5447 rptr[5] = QQ_EXPAND_LIST(((35) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5448 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5449 ctx->r = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
5450 }
5451
5452 } break;
5453 default: {
5454 lbm_value res = quote_it(qquoted);
5455 ctx->r = append(ctx->r, res);
5456 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5457 }
5458 }
5459}

5467/* Bawden's qq-expand-list implementation
5468(define (qq-expand-list x)
5469 (cond ((tag-comma? x)
5470 `(list ,(tag-data x)))
5471 ((tag-comma-atsign? x)
5472 (tag-data x))
5473 ((tag-backquote? x)
5474 (qq-expand-list
5475 (qq-expand (tag-data x))))
5476 ((pair? x)
5477 `(list
5478 (append
5479 ,(qq-expand-list (car x))
5480 ,(qq-expand (cdr x)))))
5481 (else `'(,x))))
5482*/
5483
5484static void cont_qq_expand_list(eval_context_t* ctx) {
5485 lbm_value l = ctx->K.data[--ctx->K.sp];
5486
5487 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5488 switch(lbm_type_of(l)) {
5489 case LBM_TYPE_CONS0x10000000u: {
5490 lbm_value car_val;
5491 lbm_value cdr_val;
5492 get_car_and_cdr(l, &car_val, &cdr_val);
5493
5494 if (lbm_type_of(car_val) == LBM_TYPE_SYMBOL0x00000000u &&
5495 car_val == ENC_SYM_COMMA(((0x73) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
5496 lbm_value tl = cons_with_gc(get_car(cdr_val), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5497 lbm_value tmp = cons_with_gc(ENC_SYM_LIST(((0x20014) << 4) | 0x00000000u), tl, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5498 ctx->r = append(ctx->r, tmp);
5499 return;
5500 } else if (lbm_type_of(car_val) == LBM_TYPE_SYMBOL0x00000000u &&
5501 car_val == ENC_SYM_COMMAAT(((0x74) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
5502 lbm_value cadr_val = get_car(cdr_val);
5503 ctx->r = cadr_val;
5504 return;
5505 } else {
5506 lbm_value *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx, 7);
5507 rptr[0] = QQ_LIST(((36) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5508 rptr[1] = ctx->r;
5509 rptr[2] = QQ_APPEND(((34) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5510 rptr[3] = cdr_val;
5511 rptr[4] = QQ_EXPAND(((33) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5512 rptr[5] = car_val;
5513 rptr[6] = QQ_EXPAND_LIST(((35) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5514 ctx->r = ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u);
5515 }
5516
5517 } break;
5518 default: {
5519 lbm_value a_list = cons_with_gc(l, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5520 lbm_value tl = cons_with_gc(a_list, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5521 lbm_value tmp = cons_with_gc(ENC_SYM_QUOTE(((0x100) << 4) | 0x00000000u), tl, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5522 ctx->r = append(ctx->r, tmp);
5523 }
5524 }
5525}

5527static void cont_qq_list(eval_context_t *ctx) {
5528 lbm_value val = ctx->r;
5529 lbm_value apnd_app = cons_with_gc(val, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u), ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5530 lbm_value tmp = cons_with_gc(ENC_SYM_LIST(((0x20014) << 4) | 0x00000000u), apnd_app, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5531 ctx->r = tmp;
5532 ctx->app_cont = true1;

5567// cont_recv_to:
5568//
5569// s[sp-1] = patterns
5570//
5571// ctx->r = timeout value
5572static void cont_recv_to(eval_context_t *ctx) {
5573 if (lbm_is_number(ctx->r)) {
5574 lbm_value *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 1); // patterns at sptr[0]
5575 float timeout_time = lbm_dec_as_float(ctx->r);
5576 if (timeout_time < 0.0) timeout_time = 0.0; // clamp.
5577 if (ctx->num_mail > 0) {
5578 lbm_value e;
5579 lbm_value new_env = ctx->curr_env;
5580 int n = find_match(sptr[0], ctx->mailbox, ctx->num_mail, &e, &new_env);
5581 if (n >= 0) { // match
5582 mailbox_remove_mail(ctx, (lbm_uint)n);
5583 ctx->curr_env = new_env;
5584 ctx->curr_exp = e;
5585 stack_drop(ctx, 1);
5586 return;
5587 }
5588 }
5589 // If no mail or no match, go to sleep
5590 lbm_uint *rptr = stack_reserve(ctx,2);
5591 rptr[0] = ctx->r;
5592 rptr[1] = RECV_TO_RETRY(((48) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5593 block_current_ctx(LBM_THREAD_STATE_RECV_TO(uint32_t)16u,S_TO_US(timeout_time)(lbm_uint)((timeout_time) * 1000000),true1);
5594 } else {
5595 ERROR_CTX(ENC_SYM_TERROR)error_ctx((((0x21) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5596 }
5597}
5598
5599// cont_recv_to_retry
5600//
5601// s[sp-2] = patterns
5602// s[sp-1] = timeout value
5603//
5604// ctx->r = nonsense | timeout symbol
5605static void cont_recv_to_retry(eval_context_t *ctx) {
5606 lbm_value *sptr = get_stack_ptr(ctx, 2); //sptr[0] = patterns, sptr[1] = timeout
5607
5608 if (ctx->num_mail > 0) {
5609 lbm_value e;
5610 lbm_value new_env = ctx->curr_env;
5611 int n = find_match(sptr[0], ctx->mailbox, ctx->num_mail, &e, &new_env);
5612 if (n >= 0) { // match
5613 mailbox_remove_mail(ctx, (lbm_uint)n);
5614 ctx->curr_env = new_env;
5615 ctx->curr_exp = e;
5616 stack_drop(ctx, 2);
5617 return;
5618 }
5619 }
5620
5621 // No message matched but the timeout was reached.
5622 // This is like having a recv-to with no case that matches
5623 // the timeout symbol.
5624 if (ctx->r == ENC_SYM_TIMEOUT(((0xA) << 4) | 0x00000000u)) {
5625 stack_drop(ctx, 2);
5626 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5627 return;
5628 }
5629
5630 stack_reserve(ctx,1)[0] = RECV_TO_RETRY(((48) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5631 reblock_current_ctx(LBM_THREAD_STATE_RECV_TO(uint32_t)16u,true1);
5632}

5729/*********************************************************/
5730/* Evaluator step function */
5731
5732static void evaluation_step(void){
5733 eval_context_t *ctx = ctx_running;
5734
5735 if (ctx->app_cont) {
5736 lbm_value k = ctx->K.data[--ctx->K.sp];
5737 ctx->app_cont = false0;
5738
5739 // If app_cont is true, then top of stack must be a valid continuation!
5740 // If top of stack is not a valid continuation CRASH!
5741
5742 lbm_uint decoded_k = DEC_CONTINUATION(k)(((k) & ~0xF8000001u) >> 2);
5743 continuations[decoded_k](ctx);
5744 return;
5745 }
5746
5747 if (lbm_is_symbol(ctx->curr_exp)) {
5748 eval_symbol(ctx);
5749 return;
5750 }
5751 if (lbm_is_cons(ctx->curr_exp)) {
5752 lbm_cons_t *cell = lbm_ref_cell(ctx->curr_exp);
5753 lbm_value h = cell->car;
5754 if (lbm_is_symbol(h) && ((h & ENC_SPECIAL_FORMS_MASK0xFFFFF000) == ENC_SPECIAL_FORMS_BIT0x00001000)) {
5755 lbm_uint eval_index = lbm_dec_sym(h) & SPECIAL_FORMS_INDEX_MASK0x000000FF;
5756 evaluators[eval_index](ctx);
5757 return;
5758 }
5759 /*
5760 * At this point head can be anything. It should evaluate
5761 * into a form that can be applied (closure, symbol, ...) though.
5762 */
5763 lbm_value *reserved = stack_reserve(ctx, 3);
5764 reserved[0] = ctx->curr_env; // INFER: stack_reserve aborts context if error.
5765 reserved[1] = cell->cdr;
5766 reserved[2] = APPLICATION_START(((10) << 2) | 0xF8000001u);
5767 ctx->curr_exp = h; // evaluate the function
5768 return;
5769 }
5770
5771 eval_selfevaluating(ctx);
5772 return;
5773}

5775// Placed down here since it depends on a lot of things.
5776// (apply fun arg-list)
5777static void apply_apply(lbm_value *args, lbm_uint nargs, eval_context_t *ctx) {
5778 if (nargs == 2 && lbm_is_list(args[1])) {
5779 lbm_value fun = args[0];
5780 lbm_value arg_list = args[1];
5781
5782 stack_drop(ctx, (unsigned int)nargs+1);
5783
5784 if (lbm_is_symbol(fun)) {
5785 if ((fun & ENC_SPECIAL_FORMS_MASK0xFFFFF000) == ENC_SPECIAL_FORMS_BIT0x00001000) {
5786 // Since the special form evaluators are responsible for conditionally
5787 // evaluating their arguments there is no easy way to prevent them
5788 // evaluating their arguments. Therefore we compromise and allow them to do
5789 // so, even if this isn't always how you would expect apply to work.
5790 // For instance, `(apply and '(a))` would try evaluating the symbol `a`,
5791 // instead of just returning the symbol `a` outright.
5792
5793 // Evaluator functions expect the current expression to equal the special
5794 // form, i.e. including the function symbol.
5795 lbm_value fun_and_args = cons_with_gc(fun, arg_list, ENC_SYM_NIL(((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u));
5796 ctx->curr_exp = fun_and_args;
5797 lbm_uint eval_index = lbm_dec_sym(fun) & SPECIAL_FORMS_INDEX_MASK0x000000FF;
5798 evaluators[eval_index](ctx);
5799 return;
5800 } else { // lbm_is_symbol(fun)
5801 stack_reserve(ctx, 1)[0] = fun;
5802 unsigned int arg_count = 0;
5803 for (lbm_value current = arg_list; lbm_is_cons(current);) {
5804 lbm_cons_t *cell = lbm_ref_cell(current);
5805 stack_reserve(ctx, 1)[0] = cell->car;
5806 arg_count++;
5807 current = cell->cdr;
5808 }
5809 lbm_value *fun_and_args = get_stack_ptr(ctx, arg_count + 1);
5810 application(ctx, fun_and_args, arg_count);
5811 return;
5812 }
5813 } else if (lbm_is_cons(fun)) {
5814 lbm_cons_t *fun_cell = lbm_ref_cell(fun);
5815 switch (fun_cell->car) {
5816 case ENC_SYM_CLOSURE(((0x10F) << 4) | 0x00000000u): {
5817 lbm_value closure = fun_cell->cdr;
5818 lbm_value cl0, cl1, cl2;
5819 EXTRACT(closure, cl0)do { if (lbm_is_ptr(closure)) { lbm_cons_t *_cell = lbm_ref_cell
(closure); cl0 = _cell->car; closure = _cell->cdr; } else
{ cl0 = (((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u); } } while (0); // CLO_PARAMS
5820 EXTRACT(closure, cl1)do { if (lbm_is_ptr(closure)) { lbm_cons_t *_cell = lbm_ref_cell
(closure); cl1 = _cell->car; closure = _cell->cdr; } else
{ cl1 = (((0x0) << 4) | 0x00000000u); } } while (0); // CLO_BODY
5821 EXTRACT_NO_ADVANCE(closure, cl2)do { if (lbm_is_ptr(closure)) { lbm_cons_t *_cell = lbm_ref_cell
(closure); cl2 = _cell->car; } else { cl2 = (((0x0) <<
4) | 0x00000000u); } } while (0); // CLO_ENV
5822
5823 // Only placed here to protect from GC. Will be overriden later.
5824 // ctx->r = arg_list; // Should already be placed there.
5825 ctx->curr_exp = fun;
5826
5827 lbm_value env = cl2;
5828
5829 lbm_value current_params = cl0;
5830 lbm_value current_args = arg_list;
5831 while (lbm_is_cons(current_params) && lbm_is_cons(current_args)) {
5832 lbm_cons_t *p_cell = lbm_ref_cell(current_params);
5833 lbm_cons_t *a_cell = lbm_ref_cell(current_args);
5834 env = allocate_binding(p_cell->car, a_cell->car, env);
5835 current_params = p_cell->cdr;
5836 current_args = a_cell->cdr;
5837 }
5838 if (lbm_is_cons(current_args)) {
5839 env = allocate_binding(ENC_SYM_REST_ARGS(((0x30015) << 4) | 0x00000000u), current_args, env);
5840 } else if (lbm_is_cons(current_params)) {
5841 lbm_set_error_reason(lbm_error_str_num_args);
5842 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR, fun)error_at_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u), fun);
5843 }
5844
5845 ctx->curr_env = env;
5846 ctx->curr_exp = cl1;
5847 return;
5848 }
5849 case ENC_SYM_CONT(((0x10E) << 4) | 0x00000000u):
5850 ctx->r = fun;
5851 ctx->r = setup_cont(ctx, arg_list);
5852 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5853 return;
5854 case ENC_SYM_CONT_SP(((0x118) << 4) | 0x00000000u):
5855 ctx->r = fun;
5856 ctx->r = setup_cont_sp(ctx, arg_list);
5857 ctx->app_cont = true1;
5858 return;
5859 case ENC_SYM_MACRO(((0x10D) << 4) | 0x00000000u):
5860 ctx->r = fun;
5861 setup_macro(ctx, arg_list, ctx->curr_env);
5862 return;
5863 default:
5864 lbm_set_error_reason(lbm_error_str_not_applicable);
5865 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR, fun)error_at_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u), fun);
5866 }
5867 } else {
5868 lbm_set_error_reason(lbm_error_str_not_applicable);
5869 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR, fun)error_at_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u), fun);
5870 }
5871 } else {
5872 lbm_set_error_reason(lbm_error_str_incorrect_arg);
5873 ERROR_AT_CTX(ENC_SYM_EERROR, ENC_SYM_APPLY)error_at_ctx((((0x22) << 4) | 0x00000000u), (((0x30017)
<< 4) | 0x00000000u));
5874 }
5875}

5911// Only unblocks threads that are unblockable.
5912// A sleeping thread is not unblockable.
5913static void handle_event_unblock_ctx(lbm_cid cid, lbm_value v) {
5914 eval_context_t *found = NULL((void*)0);
5915 lbm_mutex_lock(&qmutex);
5916
5917 found = lookup_ctx_nm(&blocked, cid);
5918 if (found && LBM_IS_STATE_UNBLOCKABLE(found->state)(found->state & ((uint32_t)1u | (uint32_t)2u))){
5919 unlink_ctx_nm(&blocked,found);
5920 if (lbm_is_error(v)) {
5921 get_stack_ptr(found, 1)[0] = TERMINATE(((25) << 2) | 0xF8000001u); // replace TOS
5922 found->app_cont = true1;
5923 }
5924 found->r = v;
5925 found->state = LBM_THREAD_STATE_READY(uint32_t)0u;
5926 enqueue_ctx_nm(&queue,found);
5927 }
5928 lbm_mutex_unlock(&qmutex);
5929}

5931static void handle_event_define(lbm_value key, lbm_value val) {
5932 lbm_uint dec_key = lbm_dec_sym(key);
5933 lbm_uint ix_key = dec_key & GLOBAL_ENV_MASK0x1F;
5934 lbm_value *global_env = lbm_get_global_env();
5935 lbm_uint orig_env = global_env[ix_key];
5936 lbm_value new_env;
5937 // A key is a symbol and should not need to be remembered.
5938 WITH_GC(new_env, lbm_env_set(orig_env,key,val))(new_env) = (lbm_env_set(orig_env,key,val)); if (lbm_is_symbol_merror
((new_env))) { gc(); (new_env) = (lbm_env_set(orig_env,key,val
)); if (lbm_is_symbol_merror((new_env))) { error_ctx((((0x23)
<< 4) | 0x00000000u)); } };
5939
5940 global_env[ix_key] = new_env;
5941}
5942
5943static lbm_value get_event_value(lbm_event_t *e) {
5944 lbm_value v;
5945 if (e->buf_len > 0) {
5946 lbm_flat_value_t fv;
5947 fv.buf = (uint8_t*)e->buf_ptr;
5948 fv.buf_size = e->buf_len;
5949 fv.buf_pos = 0;
5950 lbm_unflatten_value(&fv, &v);
5951 // Free the flat value buffer. GC is unaware of its existence.
5952 lbm_free(fv.buf);
5953 } else {
5954 v = (lbm_value)e->buf_ptr;
5955 }
5956 return v;
5957}
5958
5959// In a scenario where C is enqueuing events and other LBM threads
5960// are sendind mail to event handler concurrently, old events will
5961// be dropped as the backpressure mechanism wont detect this scenario.
5962// TODO: Low prio pondering on robust solutions.
5963static void process_events(void) {
5964
5965 if (!lbm_events) {
5966 return;
5967 }
5968
5969 lbm_event_t e;
5970 while (lbm_event_pop(&e)) {
5971 lbm_value event_val = get_event_value(&e);
5972 switch(e.type) {
5973 case LBM_EVENT_UNBLOCK_CTX:
5974 handle_event_unblock_ctx((lbm_cid)e.parameter, event_val);
5975 break;
5976 case LBM_EVENT_DEFINE:
5977 handle_event_define((lbm_value)e.parameter, event_val);
5978 break;
5979 case LBM_EVENT_FOR_HANDLER:
5980 if (lbm_event_handler_pid >= 0) {
5981 //If multiple events for handler, this is wasteful!
5982 // TODO: Find the event_handler once and send all mails.
5983 // However, do it with as little new code as possible.
5984 lbm_find_receiver_and_send(lbm_event_handler_pid, event_val);
5985 }
5986 break;
5987 }
5988 }
5989}

6003bool_Bool lbm_eval_step(int n) {
6004 if (setjmp(error_jmp_buf)_setjmp (error_jmp_buf) > 0) { return false0; }
6005
6006 bool_Bool busy = false0;
6007
6008 if (ctx_running) {
6009 busy = true1;
6010 while (n > 0 && ctx_running) {
6011 evaluation_step();
6012 n--;
6013 }
6014 if (ctx_running) {
6015 enqueue_ctx_nm(&queue, ctx_running);
6016 ctx_running = NULL((void*)0);
6017 }
6018 } else {
6019 if (gc_requested) gc();
6020 process_events();
6021 lbm_mutex_lock(&qmutex);
6022 wake_up_ctxs_nm();
6023 ctx_running = dequeue_ctx_nm(&queue);
6024 lbm_mutex_unlock(&qmutex);
6025 }
6026 return busy;
6027}

6036 if (!lbm_init_env()) return false0;
6037
6038 return true1;

6041#else
6042
6043/* eval_cps_run can be paused
6044 I think it would be better use a mailbox for
6045 communication between other threads and the run_eval
6046 but for now a set of variables will be used. */
6047void lbm_run_eval(void){
6048 setjmp(error_jmp_buf)_setjmp (error_jmp_buf);
6049
6050 while (eval_running) {
6051 if (eval_cps_state_changed || eval_cps_run_state == EVAL_CPS_STATE_PAUSED1) {
6052 eval_cps_state_changed = false0;
6053 switch (eval_cps_next_state) {
6054 case EVAL_CPS_STATE_RESET16:
6055 if (eval_cps_run_state != EVAL_CPS_STATE_RESET16) {
6056 is_atomic = false0;
6057 blocked.first = NULL((void*)0);
6058 blocked.last = NULL((void*)0);
6059 queue.first = NULL((void*)0);
6060 queue.last = NULL((void*)0);
6061 ctx_running = NULL((void*)0);
6062#ifdef LBM_USE_TIME_QUOTA
6063 eval_time_quota = 0; // maybe timestamp here ?
6064#else
6065 eval_steps_quota = eval_steps_refill;
6066#endif
6067 eval_cps_run_state = EVAL_CPS_STATE_RESET16;
6068 if (blocking_extension) {
6069 blocking_extension = false0;
6070 lbm_mutex_unlock(&blocking_extension_mutex);
6071 }
6072 }
6073 usleep_callback(EVAL_CPS_MIN_SLEEP200);
6074 continue;
6075 case EVAL_CPS_STATE_PAUSED1:
6076 if (eval_cps_run_state != EVAL_CPS_STATE_PAUSED1) {
6077 if (lbm_heap_num_free() < eval_cps_next_state_arg) {
6078 gc();
6079 }
6080 eval_cps_next_state_arg = 0;
6081 eval_cps_run_state = EVAL_CPS_STATE_PAUSED1;
6082 }
6083 usleep_callback(EVAL_CPS_MIN_SLEEP200);
6084 continue;
6085 case EVAL_CPS_STATE_KILL4:
6086 eval_cps_run_state = EVAL_CPS_STATE_DEAD8;
6087 eval_running = false0;
6088 continue;
6089 default: // running state
6090 eval_cps_run_state = eval_cps_next_state;
6091 break;
6092 }
6093 }
6094 while (true1) {
6095#ifdef LBM_USE_TIME_QUOTA
6096 // Is "negative" (closer to max value) when the quota timestamp is "ahead
6097 // of" the current timestamp. It handles the quota being very large while
6098 // the current timestamp has overflowed back to being small, giving a
6099 // "positive" (closer to min value) result, meaning the context will be
6100 // switched.
6101 uint32_t unsigned_difference = lbm_timestamp() - eval_current_quota;
6102 bool_Bool is_negative = unsigned_difference & (1u << 31);
6103 if (is_negative && ctx_running) {
6104 evaluation_step();
6105 } else {
6106 if (eval_cps_state_changed) break;
6107 if (!is_atomic) {
6108 if (gc_requested) {
6109 gc();
6110 }
6111 process_events();
6112 lbm_mutex_lock(&qmutex);
6113 if (ctx_running) {
6114 enqueue_ctx_nm(&queue, ctx_running);
6115 ctx_running = NULL((void*)0);
6116 }
6117 wake_up_ctxs_nm();
6118 ctx_running = dequeue_ctx_nm(&queue);
6119 lbm_mutex_unlock(&qmutex);
6120 if (!ctx_running) {
6121 lbm_system_sleeping = true1;
6122 //Fixed sleep interval to poll events regularly.
6123 usleep_callback(EVAL_CPS_MIN_SLEEP200);
6124 lbm_system_sleeping = false0;
6125 }
6126 }
6127 // Assign a new quota last.
6128 // This means that the time it takes in finding a context to dequeue
6129 // and the other work above is not included in the woken up contexts quota.
6130 //
6131 // Earlier the new quota was assigned at the top of this branch,
6132 // If that happened such that timestamp + eval_time_refil ends
6133 // up to be just shy of an overflow, going through all the rest of
6134 // logic could potentially overflow the timestamp and create a situation
6135 // where the scheduled task has a humongous quota!
6136 eval_current_quota = lbm_timestamp() + eval_time_refill;
6137 }
6138#else
6139 if (eval_steps_quota && ctx_running) {
6140 eval_steps_quota--;
6141 evaluation_step();
6142 } else {
6143 if (eval_cps_state_changed) break;
6144 eval_steps_quota = eval_steps_refill;
6145 if (!is_atomic) {
6146 if (gc_requested) {
6147 gc();
6148 }
6149 process_events();
6150 lbm_mutex_lock(&qmutex);
6151 if (ctx_running) {
6152 enqueue_ctx_nm(&queue, ctx_running);
6153 ctx_running = NULL((void*)0);
6154 }
6155 wake_up_ctxs_nm();
6156 ctx_running = dequeue_ctx_nm(&queue);
6157 lbm_mutex_unlock(&qmutex);
6158 if (!ctx_running) {
6159 lbm_system_sleeping = true1;
6160 //Fixed sleep interval to poll events regularly.
6161 usleep_callback(EVAL_CPS_MIN_SLEEP200);
6162 lbm_system_sleeping = false0;
6163 }
6164 }
6165 }
6166#endif
6167 }
6168 }
6169}

6174 qmutex_initialized = true1;

6176 if (!lbm_events_mutex_initialized) {

6187
6188 is_atomic = false0;
6189 blocked.first = NULL((void*)0);
6190 blocked.last = NULL((void*)0);

6196
6197 lbm_mutex_unlock(&lbm_events_mutex);
6198 lbm_mutex_unlock(&qmutex);
6199
6200 if (!lbm_init_env()) return false0;
6201 eval_running = true1;
6202 return true1;
6203}
